    """WP3c shadow: classify findings via lightweight LLM call.

@dataclass
class CellVerdict:
    """A single verdict from one immune cell on one finding."""
    cell_type: CellType
    finding_id: str
    verdict: str          # CONFIRMED, REJECTED, UNCERTAIN, DUPLICATE, NOVEL
    confidence: float     # 0.0–1.0
    evidence: str         # explanation
    tool_used: str        # which tool produced this verdict
    elapsed_s: float = 0.0


@dataclass
class TriagedFinding:
    """Finding annotated by Dendritic Cell with claim classification."""
    finding: Finding
    claim_type: ClaimType
    extracted_claim: str = ""       # the testable assertion pulled from description
    is_duplicate: bool = False      # NK Cell flag
    duplicate_of: Optional[str] = None
    similarity: float = 0.0


@dataclass
class ImmuneResponse:
    """Complete immune response for a batch of findings."""
    triaged: List[TriagedFinding]
    cell_verdicts: Dict[str, List[CellVerdict]]  # finding_id → verdicts
    final_verdicts: Dict[str, str]               # finding_id → CONFIRMED/REJECTED/UNCERTAIN
    final_confidences: Dict[str, float]           # finding_id → aggregated confidence
    filtered_findings: List[Finding]              # findings that survived filtering
    rejected_findings: List[Finding]              # findings removed by immune response
    rejection_rate: float
    autoimmune_flag: bool           # True if Regulatory T flagged over-rejection
    stage_timings: Dict[str, float]
    tool_usage: Dict[str, int]      # tool_name → times_used
    observation_only: bool          # if True, filtered_findings == all findings
    barrier_results: List[Any] = field(default_factory=list)  # SkinBarrierResult list


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Claim detection patterns
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

_MATH_PATTERN = re.compile(
    r"(?:"
    r"[=<>!]=?"
    r"|[+\-*/^]"
    r"|\bsqrt\b|\blog\b|\bexp\b"
    r"|\b\d+\s*[*/+\-]"
    r"|\bEq\(|\bGt\(|\bLt\("
    r"|\bbound\b|\bthreshold\b|\binequality\b"
    r"|\bformula\b|\bequation\b"
    r")"
)

_LOGIC_PATTERN = re.compile(
    r"(?:"
    r"\bif\b.*\bthen\b"
    r"|\breachable\b|\bunreachable\b"
    r"|\binvariant\b|\bprecondition\b|\bpostcondition\b"
    r"|\bimplies\b|\bcontradiction\b"
    r"|\balways\b.*\bnever\b|\bnever\b.*\balways\b"
    r")",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)

_STAT_PATTERN = re.compile(
    r"(?:"
    # MF-31 fix: match p-values with or without leading zero (e.g. .05, 0.05)
    r"\bsignificant\b|\bp-value\b|\bp\s*[<=]\s*0?\.\d"
    r"|\bdistribution\b|\bcorrelation\b|\bregression\b"
    r"|\bmean\b.*\bdiffer\b|\bvariance\b"
    r"|\bKruskal\b|\bWilcoxon\b|\bt-test\b|\bchi-squared\b"
    r")",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)

_STRUCT_PATTERN = re.compile(
    r"(?:"
    r"@\w+\s+decorator"
    r"|\bmissing\b.*\bmethod\b|\bmethod\b.*\bmissing\b"
    r"|\bno\b.*\bclass\b|\bclass\b.*\bnot\s+defined\b"
    r"|\bdecorator\b.*\bnot\s+found\b"
    r")",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 1. DENDRITIC CELL — Triage and classification
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

def _classify_claim(finding: Finding) -> Tuple[ClaimType, str]:
    """Classify a finding's claim type and extract the testable assertion."""
    desc = finding.description

    # Check specific patterns before generic math (which matches broadly)
    if _STAT_PATTERN.search(desc):
        return ClaimType.STATISTICAL, desc

    if _LOGIC_PATTERN.search(desc):
        return ClaimType.LOGICAL, desc

    if _STRUCT_PATTERN.search(desc):
        return ClaimType.CODE_STRUCTURAL, desc

    if _MATH_PATTERN.search(desc):
        # MF-03/MF-04 fix: extract ALL backtick expressions (not just first)
        # and preserve surrounding context for preconditions
        # Bug#17 fix: use ", " separator instead of " AND " (invalid SymPy syntax)
        eq_matches = re.findall(r'`([^`]+[=<>+\-*/^][^`]+)`', desc)
        if eq_matches:
            claim = ", ".join(eq_matches) if len(eq_matches) > 1 else eq_matches[0]
        else:
            claim = desc
        return ClaimType.MATHEMATICAL, claim

    # Default: behavioural code claim (most findings are about code bugs)
    return ClaimType.CODE_BEHAVIORAL, desc


def dendritic_cell_triage(findings: List[Finding]) -> List[TriagedFinding]:
    """Stage 1: Classify all findings by claim type.

    The Dendritic Cell bridges innate and adaptive immunity by
    determining which verification pathway each finding needs.
    Fast, pure-Python, no external tools.
    """
    triaged = []
    for f in findings:
        claim_type, extracted = _classify_claim(f)
        triaged.append(TriagedFinding(
            finding=f,
            claim_type=claim_type,
            extracted_claim=extracted,
        ))
    return triaged

# 2. CYTOTOXIC T-CELL — Structurally-enforced code investigation
#
# The CT agent is an INVESTIGATOR, not a judge. It reads source code and
# reports what it found at specific file:line locations. Its claims are
# then MECHANICALLY VERIFIED against the actual source by _verify_ct_claim().
# The verdict is determined by code, not by the agent's opinion.
#
# Structural enforcement:
#   1. Output schema (ct_verdict_schema.json) forces structured evidence
#   2. Each evidence item must cite file, line, and code_snippet
#   3. _verify_ct_claim() reads the real file at the real line and checks
#      whether the snippet matches — if it doesn't, confidence drops to 0
#   4. Verdict is computed from verification results, not from agent text
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

def formalisation_agent(
    triaged: List[TriagedFinding],
    b_cell_verdicts: List[CellVerdict],
) -> Tuple[List[Dict[str, Any]], List[CellVerdict]]:
    """WP3d ACTIVE: extract and formalise preconditions for B-Cell claims.

    For each MATHEMATICAL or LOGICAL finding:
    1. Extract natural language preconditions from the description
    2. Translate to Z3 constraint fragments
    3. Compare: did the B-Cell's verdict change when preconditions are
       accounted for? (i.e., would the Formalisation Agent have prevented
       a false rejection?)

    ACTIVE (promoted from shadow, Exp 38 fix cycle):
    When a potential false rejection is detected (B-Cell REJECTED a claim
    that has extractable preconditions), produces an UNCERTAIN counter-verdict.
    This feeds into the reconciliation gate, preventing context-erasure
    false rejections from being locked.

    Returns (comparisons, counter_verdicts).
    """
    comparisons: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    counter_verdicts: List[CellVerdict] = []

    # Build B-Cell verdict lookup
    bcell_verdicts: Dict[str, CellVerdict] = {}
    for v in b_cell_verdicts:
        if v.cell_type == CellType.B_CELL:
            bcell_verdicts[v.finding_id] = v

    for tf in triaged:
        if tf.claim_type not in (ClaimType.MATHEMATICAL, ClaimType.LOGICAL):
            continue
        if tf.is_duplicate:
            continue

        fid = tf.finding.finding_id
        desc = tf.finding.description

        # Step 1: extract preconditions
        preconditions = _extract_preconditions(desc)

        # Step 2: attempt Z3 translation
        z3_fragment = _preconditions_to_z3(preconditions, tf.extracted_claim)

        # Step 3: compare against B-Cell verdict
        bcell_v = bcell_verdicts.get(fid)
        bcell_verdict = bcell_v.verdict if bcell_v else "NO_VERDICT"

        # Would preconditions have mattered?
        # A REJECTED verdict on a claim with extractable preconditions
        # is a candidate for false rejection (context erasure).
        potential_false_rejection = (
            bcell_verdict == "REJECTED"
            and len(preconditions) > 0
        )

        record = {
            "finding_id": fid,
            "claim_type": tf.claim_type.value,
            "preconditions_found": len(preconditions),
            "preconditions": preconditions,
            "z3_fragment": z3_fragment,
            "z3_translatable": z3_fragment is not None,
            "bcell_verdict": bcell_verdict,
            "potential_false_rejection": potential_false_rejection,
        }
        comparisons.append(record)

        if potential_false_rejection:
            # ACTIVE: produce counter-verdict to prevent false rejection lock
            counter_verdicts.append(CellVerdict(
                cell_type=CellType.B_CELL,
                finding_id=fid,
                verdict="UNCERTAIN",
                confidence=0.45,
                evidence=(
                    f"[Formalisation] B-Cell REJECTED with {len(preconditions)} "
                    f"extractable preconditions — potential context-erasure "
                    f"false rejection. Preconditions: {preconditions}. "
                    f"Z3 translatable: {z3_fragment is not None}"
                ),
                tool_used="formalisation_agent",
            ))
            _shadow_log.info(
                "Formalisation agent: %s — REJECTED with %d preconditions "
                "(potential false rejection, counter-verdict issued). "
                "Preconditions: %s",
                fid, len(preconditions), preconditions,
            )
        elif preconditions:

def cytotoxic_t_cell(
    triaged: List[TriagedFinding],
    source_paths: List[str],
    timeout: int = 180,
) -> List[CellVerdict]:
    """Stage 2a: Structurally-enforced code investigation via claude CLI.

    The CT agent is an INVESTIGATOR, not a judge:
    1. Schema enforcement forces structured evidence output
    2. Each evidence item cites file:line:code_snippet
    3. _verify_ct_claim() mechanically checks each citation
    4. Verdict is computed from verification results, not agent opinion

    If the agent's citations don't match the actual code, confidence
    drops to zero regardless of what the agent claimed.
    """
    code_findings = [
        tf for tf in triaged
        if tf.claim_type in (ClaimType.CODE_BEHAVIORAL, ClaimType.CODE_STRUCTURAL)
        and not tf.is_duplicate
    ]

    if not code_findings:
        return []

    if not _get_claude_cli():
        return [
            CellVerdict(
                cell_type=CellType.CYTOTOXIC_T,
                finding_id=tf.finding.finding_id,
                verdict="UNCERTAIN",
                confidence=0.0,
                evidence="claude CLI not available",
                tool_used="none",
            )
            for tf in code_findings
        ]

    prompt = _build_ct_prompt(code_findings, source_paths)
    t0 = time.monotonic()

    try:
        cmd = [
            _get_claude_cli(), "-p", prompt,
            "--allowedTools", "Read,Grep,Glob",
            "--max-turns", "4",
        ]
        # Enforce output schema if available
        if _CT_SCHEMA_PATH.exists():
            cmd.extend(["--output-format", "json"])

        # Bug#4 fix: serialise claude CLI calls to prevent contention
        with _CLAUDE_CLI_LOCK:
            result = sp.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout)
        elapsed = time.monotonic() - t0
        output = result.stdout.strip()

        # Parse the structured response
        raw_verdicts = _parse_ct_output(output)

        # Mechanically verify each evidence item
        verdicts: List[CellVerdict] = []
        seen: Set[str] = set()
        for rv in raw_verdicts:
            fid = rv.get("finding_id", "")
            if not fid or fid in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(fid)

            # C5-01: pass source_paths as allowed_dirs for path traversal protection
            # Bug#5 fix: filter empty strings from dirname (bare filenames)
            allowed_dirs = [d for d in (os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(p)) for p in source_paths) if d] if source_paths else None
            verdict = _ct_evidence_to_verdict(
                finding_id=fid,
                claim_type=rv.get("claim_type", ""),
                evidence_items=rv.get("evidence", []),
                allowed_dirs=allowed_dirs,

def b_cell_verify(triaged: List[TriagedFinding]) -> List[CellVerdict]:
    """Stage 2b: Mathematical/logical/statistical verification.

    The B-Cell uses somatic hypermutation — it adapts its verification
    strategy based on the claim type. Mathematical claims get SymPy,
    logical claims get z3, statistical claims get statsmodels.
    Cross-verification (class switching): if SymPy returns UNCERTAIN,
    try z3 as a fallback.
    """
    verdicts: List[CellVerdict] = []

    for tf in triaged:
        if tf.is_duplicate:
            continue

        fid = tf.finding.finding_id
        v: Optional[CellVerdict] = None

        if tf.claim_type == ClaimType.MATHEMATICAL:
            v = _verify_sympy(tf.extracted_claim)
            # Class switching: if SymPy uncertain, try z3
            if v.verdict == "UNCERTAIN":
                v2 = _verify_z3(tf.extracted_claim)
                if v2.verdict != "UNCERTAIN":
                    v = v2
                    v.evidence += " [class-switched from SymPy]"

        elif tf.claim_type == ClaimType.LOGICAL:
            v = _verify_z3(tf.extracted_claim)

        elif tf.claim_type == ClaimType.STATISTICAL:
            v = _verify_statistical(tf.extracted_claim)

        if v is not None:
            v.finding_id = fid
            verdicts.append(v)

    return verdicts

def nk_cell_verify(
    triaged: List[TriagedFinding],
    prior_findings: List[Finding],
    tau_sim: float = 0.50,  # Raised from 0.33: class_match base (0.30) + shared
                            # vocabulary caused 90-100% false DUPLICATE by mid-run.
                            # At 0.50, same-class needs Jaccard >= 0.286 (real overlap).
    false_positive_db: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = None,
) -> Tuple[List[TriagedFinding], List[CellVerdict]]:
    """Stage 2c: Pattern recognition and deduplication.

    The NK Cell provides innate-like immunity with adaptive memory.
    It matches findings against:
    1. Prior findings (dedup via similarity)
    2. Known false-positive patterns (memory from prior runs)
    3. Anomaly detection (severity outliers, repeated hallucinations)

    Returns updated triaged findings with duplicate flags set,
    plus verdicts for pattern-matched findings.
    """
    fp_db = false_positive_db or _KNOWN_FALSE_POSITIVES
    verdicts: List[CellVerdict] = []

    for tf in triaged:
        f = tf.finding

        # 1. Dedup against prior findings
        # MF-19 fix: early termination once a match exceeds threshold
        best_sim = 0.0
        best_match: Optional[str] = None
        for pf in prior_findings:
            sim = _finding_similarity(f, pf)
            if sim > best_sim:
                best_sim = sim
                best_match = pf.finding_id
                if best_sim >= tau_sim:
                    break  # MF-19: early termination

def _verdict_domain(v: CellVerdict) -> str:
    """Map a verdict to its verification domain."""
    tool = v.tool_used.lower()
    if any(k in tool for k in ("ct", "falsif", "code", "snippet")):
        return _DOMAIN_CODE
    elif any(k in tool for k in ("sympy", "z3", "smt", "stats")):
        return _DOMAIN_MATH
    elif any(k in tool for k in ("dedup", "false_positive", "anomaly", "similar")):
        return _DOMAIN_PATTERN
    return _DOMAIN_CODE  # default


def _confidence_to_log_odds(c: float) -> float:
    """Convert confidence [0,1] to log-odds magnitude, clamped to avoid infinity.

    Bug#33 fix: confidence is a magnitude (how certain the cell is about its
    verdict), not a probability of correctness. A REJECTED verdict with
    confidence 0.3 means "weakly certain it's rejected", not "30% chance".
    We clamp the floor to 0.5 so that low-confidence verdicts contribute
    near-zero log-odds rather than negative (which would invert the signal).
    """
    c = max(0.50, min(0.99, c))
    return _math.log(c / (1.0 - c))


def _log_odds_to_confidence(lo: float) -> float:
    """Convert log-odds back to confidence [0,1]."""
    return 1.0 / (1.0 + _math.exp(-abs(lo)))


def helper_t_v2(
    triaged: List[TriagedFinding],
    all_verdicts: List[CellVerdict],
    rejection_asymmetry: float = 0.7,
) -> Tuple[Dict[str, str], Dict[str, float]]:
    """Helper T Cell v2: hybrid domain-based synthesis.

    Two-level aggregation:
    1. Within each domain (code, math, pattern): log-odds aggregation
       of multiple signals from the same verification method.
    2. Across domains: max effective signal wins, with asymmetric
       scaling on rejection evidence (0.7 factor).
    """
    verdicts_by_finding: Dict[str, List[CellVerdict]] = {}
    for v in all_verdicts:
        verdicts_by_finding.setdefault(v.finding_id, []).append(v)

    final_verdicts: Dict[str, str] = {}
    final_confidences: Dict[str, float] = {}

    for tf in triaged:
        fid = tf.finding.finding_id
        fv = verdicts_by_finding.get(fid, [])

        # Auto-reject duplicates
        if tf.is_duplicate:
            final_verdicts[fid] = "DUPLICATE"
            final_confidences[fid] = tf.similarity
            continue

        if not fv:
            final_verdicts[fid] = "UNCERTAIN"
            final_confidences[fid] = 0.0
            continue

        # ── Level 1: Within-domain aggregation (log-odds) ──
        domain_verdicts: Dict[str, List[CellVerdict]] = {}
        for v in fv:
            d = _verdict_domain(v)
            domain_verdicts.setdefault(d, []).append(v)

        domain_results: Dict[str, Tuple[str, float]] = {}

        for domain, dvs in domain_verdicts.items():
            confirms = [v for v in dvs if v.verdict == "CONFIRMED"]
            rejects = [v for v in dvs if v.verdict in ("REJECTED", "DUPLICATE")]

            if not confirms and not rejects:
                domain_results[domain] = ("UNCERTAIN", 0.0)
                continue

            if len(confirms) + len(rejects) == 1:
                # Single signal: use directly (identity operation)
                v = (confirms or rejects)[0]
                domain_results[domain] = (v.verdict, v.confidence)
            else:
                # Multiple signals: log-odds aggregation
                confirm_lo = sum(
                    _confidence_to_log_odds(v.confidence) for v in confirms
                )
                reject_lo = sum(
                    _confidence_to_log_odds(v.confidence) for v in rejects
                )

                if confirm_lo >= reject_lo:
                    agg_conf = _log_odds_to_confidence(confirm_lo)
                    domain_results[domain] = ("CONFIRMED", agg_conf)
                else:
                    agg_conf = _log_odds_to_confidence(reject_lo)
                    domain_results[domain] = ("REJECTED", agg_conf)

        # ── Level 2: Across-domain (max signal wins) ──
        best_confirm = 0.0
        best_reject = 0.0

        for domain, (verdict, conf) in domain_results.items():
            if verdict == "CONFIRMED":
                best_confirm = max(best_confirm, conf)
            elif verdict in ("REJECTED", "DUPLICATE"):
                best_reject = max(best_reject, conf)

        # Asymmetric scaling: rejection must overcome 0.7 barrier
        effective_reject = best_reject * rejection_asymmetry

Mathematical claims get SymPy,\n    logical claims get z3, statistical claims get statsmodels.\n    Cross-verification (class switching): if SymPy returns UNCERTAIN,\n    try z3 as a fallback.\n    \"\"\"\n    verdicts: List[CellVerdict] = []\n\n    for tf in triaged:\n        if tf.is_duplicate:\n            continue\n\n        fid = tf.finding.finding_id\n        v: Optional[CellVerdict] = None\n\n        if tf.claim_type == ClaimType.MATHEMATICAL:\n            v = _verify_sympy(tf.extracted_claim)\n            # Class switching: if SymPy uncertain, try z3\n            if v.verdict == \"UNCERTAIN\":\n                v2 = _verify_z3(tf.extracted_claim)\n                if v2.verdict != \"UNCERTAIN\":\n                    v = v2\n                    v.evidence += \" [class-switched from SymPy]\"\n\n        elif tf.claim_type == ClaimType.LOGICAL:\n            v = _verify_z3(tf.extracted_claim)\n\n        elif tf.claim_type == ClaimType.STATISTICAL:\n            v = _verify_statistical(tf.extracted_claim)\n\n        if v is not None:\n            v.finding_id = fid\n            verdicts.append(v)\n\n    return verdicts\n\n\n# \u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\n# 4. NK CELL \u2014 Pattern recognition, dedup, and immune memory\n# \u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\n\n# Known false-positive patterns from Run 7b analysis\n# MF-18 fix: add re.DOTALL to FP patterns for multiline descriptions\n_KNOWN_FALSE_POSITIVES: List[Dict[str, Any]] = [\n    {\n        \"pattern\": re.compile(r\"@dataclass\\s+decorator.*missing\", re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL),\n        \"source\": \"Run 7b: Codex hallucinated missing @dataclass 8 times\",\n        \"expected_model\": \"Codex\",\n    },\n    {\n        \"pattern\": re.compile(r\"missing\\s+@dataclass\", re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL),\n        \"source\": \"Run 7b: @dataclass false positive cluster\",\n        \"expected_model\": \"Codex\",\n    },\n]\n\n\ndef nk_cell_verify(\n    triaged: List[TriagedFinding],\n    prior_findings: List[Finding],\n    tau_sim: float = 0.33,  # Calibrated from Run 8: max sim 0.553 at old 0.8\n    false_positive_db: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = None,\n) -> Tuple[List[TriagedFinding], List[CellVerdict]]:\n    \"\"\"Stage 2c: Pattern recognition and deduplication.\n\n    The NK Cell provides innate-like immunity with adaptive memory.\n    It matches findings against:\n    1. already has a programmatically verified fix, this bug is closed.\n            matched_pf = next(\n                (pf for pf in prior_findings if pf.finding_id == best_match),\n                None,\n            )\n            has_fix = (\n                matched_pf is not None\n                and bool(matched_pf.proposed_fix.strip())\n                and matched_pf.verified\n            )\n            is_escalated = (\n                matched_pf is not None\n                and matched_pf.escalated\n            )\n            tf.is_duplicate = True\n            tf.duplicate_of = best_match\n            tf.similarity = best_sim\n            if has_fix:\n                _evidence = f\"Bug CLOSED \u2014 dup of {best_match} (sim={best_sim:.3f}), fix exists\"\n                _tool = \"bug_closed\"\n            elif is_escalated:\n                _evidence = f\"Bug ESCALATED \u2014 dup of {best_match} (sim={best_sim:.3f}), awaiting HIL\"\n                _tool = \"escalated\"\n            else:\n                _evidence = f\"Duplicate of {best_match} (sim={best_sim:.3f})\"\n                _tool = \"similarity_dedup\"\n            verdicts.append(CellVerdict(\n                cell_type=CellType.NK_CELL,\n                finding_id=f.finding_id,\n                verdict=\"DUPLICATE\",\n                confidence=best_sim,\n                evidence=_evidence,\n                tool_used=_tool,\n            ))\n            continue\n\n        # HELPER T-CELL \u2014 Verdict synthesis\n# \u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\n\ndef helper_t_cell_synthesize(\n    triaged: List[TriagedFinding],\n    all_verdicts: List[CellVerdict],\n) -> Tuple[Dict[str, str], Dict[str, float]]:\n    \"\"\"Stage 3a: Synthesize all cell verdicts into final judgments.\n\n    The Helper T-Cell coordinates the immune response by aggregating\n    verdicts from all cell types. Uses confidence-weighted voting:\n    - CONFIRMED verdicts contribute positive weight\n    - REJECTED verdicts contribute negative weight\n    - UNCERTAIN verdicts contribute nothing\n    - DUPLICATE verdicts are auto-rejected\n\n    A finding needs net positive confidence to survive.\n    Asymmetric threshold: rejection requires 0.6+ net confidence,\n    confirmation requires only 0.4+ (false negatives are costlier\n    than false positives).\n    \"\"\"\n    # UNCERTAIN contributes nothing\n\n        total = confirm_weight + reject_weight\n        if total == 0:\n            # No verdicts \u2014 pass through (precautionary principle)\n            final_verdicts[fid] = \"UNCERTAIN\"\n            final_confidences[fid] = 0.0\n        elif reject_weight / max(total, 0.001) >= 0.6:\n            final_verdicts[fid] = \"REJECTED\"\n            # ({rejected/total:.1%}) \"\n            f\"exceeds threshold ({max_rejection_rate:.0%})\"\n        )\n\n    # Check 1b (MF-36 fix): High UNCERTAIN rate indicates fail-open illusion\n    uncertain = rejections\n    # (indicates a miscalibrated tool, not genuine false positives)\n    # We'd need per-cell rejection counts here \u2014 tracked via verdicts\n\n    # Check 3: All findings from one \u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\n# Convergence summary (one line, mechanical)\n            if round_idx > 0:\n                try:\n                    kappa = self.conv_detector.kappa(round_idx - 1)\n                    conv_summary = f\"Convergence: kappa={kappa:.3f} (threshold={self.config.tau_kappa})\"\n                except Exception:\n                    conv_summary = \"Convergence: insufficient data\"\n            else:\n                conv_summary = \"Round 0: blind round (no prior data)\"\n\n            total_findings = sum(len(rnd) for rnd in self.state.all_findings)\n\n            payloads[model_label] = RelayPayload(\n                model_label=model_label,\n                round_idx=round_idx,\n                findings_text=findings_text,\n                finding_count=total_findings,\n                context_reset=context_reset,\n                convergence_summary=conv_summary,\n                active_models=list(self.state.active_models),\n            )\n\n        logger.info(\n            \"Relay prepared for round %d: %d models, %d total findings\",\n            round_idx, len(payloads),\n            sum(len(rnd) for rnd in self.state.all_findings),\n        )\n        return payloads\n\n    def _format_findings_for_model(\n        self,\n        model_label: str,\n        round_idx: int,\n    ) -> Tuple[str, bool]:\n        \"\"\"Format prior findings for a specific model.\n\n        Cross-pollination: exclude model's own findings.\n        Budget-aware: switch to summary-only if over budget.\n\n        Returns (formatted_text, context_reset_flag).\n        \"\"\"\n        if not self.state.all_findings:\n            return \"\", False\n\n        # Budget for this model\n        budget = self.config.context_budget_overrides.get(\n            model_label, self.config.context_budget_chars,\n        )\n\n        # Cross-pollination: other models' findings only\n        cross_findings: List[Finding] = []\n        for rnd in self.state.all_findings:\n            for f in rnd:\n                if f.model_id != model_label:\n                    cross_findings.append(f)\n\n        if not cross_findings:\n            return \"\", False\n\n        # Try full format first\n        full_text = self._format_findings_full(cross_findings)\n        if len(full_text) <= budget:\n            return full_text, False\n\n        # Over budget \u2014 try last round only\n        if self.state.all_findings:\n            last_round = [\n                f for f in self.state.all_findings[-1]\n                if f.model_id != model_label\n            ]\n            last_text = self._format_findings_full(last_round)\n            if len(last_text) <= budget:\n                header = (\n                    f\"(CONTEXT BUDGET: showing last round only. \"\n                    f\"{len(cross_findings)} total prior findings exist.)\\n\\n\"\n                )\n                return header + last_text, False\n\n        # Still over \u2014 summary-only mode (context reset)\n        summary = self._format_findings_summary(cross_findings)\n        return summary, True\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def _format_findings_full(findings: List[Finding]) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Format findings as full text. Mechanical \u2014 no editorial changes.\"\"\"\n        lines = []\n        for f in findings:\n            lines.append(\n                f\"[{f.finding_id}] model={f.model_id} round={f.round_idx} \"\n                f\"severity={f.severity:.2f}\\n\"\n                f\"  {f.description}\\n\"\n                f\"  Fix: {f.proposed_fix}\\n\"\n            )\n        return \"\\n\".join(lines)\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def _format_findings_summary(findings: List[Finding]) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Format findings as summary only (ID + severity + one line).\n\n        Used when full text exceeds context budget. This is a context reset.\n        Findings with accepted fixes are marked CLOSED \u2014 models must not\n        relitigate these. First sufficient fix wins (Occam's razor).\n        \"\"\"\n        # CLOSED = fix exists AND programmatically verified (tools passed)\n        closed = [f for f in findings if f.proposed_fix.strip() and f.verified]\n        # ESCALATED = no programmatic fix possible, awaiting human decision\n        escalated = [f for f in findings if f.escalated and not f.verified]\n        # PENDING = fix proposed but not yet verified by tools\n        pending = [f for f in findings\n                   if f.proposed_fix.strip() and not f.verified and not f.escalated]\n        # OPEN = no fix proposed, not escalated\n        open_findings = [f for f in findings\n                         if not f.proposed_fix.strip() and not f.escalated and not f.verified]\n\n        lines = []\n        lines.append(\n            f\"(CONTEXT RESET: {len(findings)} prior findings exist. \"\n            f\"{len(closed)} CLOSED, {len(escalated)} ESCALATED, \"\n            f\"{len(pending)} PENDING, {len(open_findings)} OPEN. \"\n            f\"Do NOT relitigate CLOSED or ESCALATED bugs. \"\n            f\"Find NEW issues only.)\\n\"\n        )\n\n        if closed:\n            lines.append(\"\u2500\u2500 CLOSED (verified fix \u2014 do not relitigate) \u2500\u2500\")\n            for f in closed:\n                desc_clean = f.description.replace(\"\\n\", \" \")\n                desc_short = desc_clean[:57] + \"...\" if len(desc_clean) > 60 else desc_clean\n                lines.append(\n                    f\"  [CLOSED] {f.finding_id} (sev={f.severity:.2f}): {desc_short}\"\n                )\n            lines.append(\"\")\n\n        if escalated:\n            lines.append(\"\u2500\u2500 ESCALATED (awaiting human decision \u2014 do not attempt to fix) \u2500\u2500\")\n            for f in escalated:\n                desc_clean = f.description.replace(\"\\n\", \" \")\n                desc_short = desc_clean[:57] + \"...\" if len(desc_clean) > 60 else desc_clean\n                lines.append(\n                    f\"  [ESCALATED] {f.finding_id} (sev={f.severity:.2f}): {desc_short}\"\n                )\n            lines.append(\"\")\n\n        if pending:\n            lines.append(\"\u2500\u2500 PENDING (fix proposed, awaiting tool verification) \u2500\u2500\")\n            for f in pending:\n                desc_clean = f.description.replace(\"\\n\", \" \")\n                desc_short = desc_clean[:67] + \"...\" if len(desc_clean) > 70 else desc_clean\n                lines.append(\n                    f\"  [PENDING] {f.finding_id} (sev={f.severity:.2f}): {desc_short}\"\n                )\n            lines.append(\"\")\n\n        if open_findings:\n            lines.append(\"\u2500\u2500 OPEN (no fix yet \u2014 contributions welcome) \u2500\u2500\")\n            for f in open_findings:\n                desc_clean = f.description.replace(\"\\n\", \" \")\n                desc_short = desc_clean[:77] + \"...\" if len(desc_clean) > 80 else desc_clean\n                lines.append(\n                    f\"  {f.finding_id} (sev={f.severity:.2f}): {desc_short}\"\n                )\n\n        return    # Core function 1b: relay_conversational()\n    #    def relay_conversational(self, round_idx: int) -> Dict[str, RelayPayload]:\n        \"\"\"Prepare conversational relay payloads \u2014 full model responses.\n\n        Like relay(), but passes raw       return payloads\n\n    def _format_responses_for_model(\n        self,\n        model_label: str,\n        round_idx: int,\n    ) -> Tuple[str, bool]:\n        \"\"\"Format other models' full responses for a specific model.\n\n        Cross-pollination: exclude model's own responses.\n        Budget-aware: degrade gracefully when over budget.\n        Degradation ladder: full text \u2192 last round only \u2192 findings summary.\n        \"\"\"\n        if not self.state.round_records:\n            return \"\", False\n\n        budget = self.config.context_budget_overrides.get(\n            model_label, self.config.context_budget_chars,\n        )\n\n        # Collect all other models' responses, attributed\n        all_sections: List[Tuple[int, str, str]] = []  # (round, label, text)\n        for record in self.state.round_records:\n            for resp_label, resp_text in record.model_responses.items():\n                if resp_label != model_label and resp_text:\n                    all_sections.append((record.round_idx, resp_label, resp_text))\n\n        if not all_sections:\n            return \"\", False\n\n        # Try full responses\n        full_text = self._render_response_sections(all_sections)\n        if len(full_text) <= budget:\n            return full_text, False\n\n        # Over budget \u2014 last round only\n        last_round_idx = self.state.round_records[-1].round_idx\n        last_sections = [(r, label, txt) for r, label, txt in all_sections if r == last_round_idx]\n        last_text = self._render_response_sections(last_sections)\n\n        if len(last_text) <= budget:\n            n_earlier = len(all_sections) - len(last_sections)\n            header = (\n                f\"(CONTEXT BUDGET: showing last round responses only. \"\n                f\"{n_earlier} earlier responses from other models exist.)\\n\\n\"\n            )\n            return header + last_text, False\n\n        # Still over \u2014 fall back to findings summary (context reset)\n        cross_findings: List[Finding] = []\n        for rnd in self.state.all_findings:\n            for f in rnd:\n                if f.model_id != model_label:\n                    cross_findings.append(f)\n        return self._format_findings_summary(cross_findings), True\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def _render_response_sections(\n        sections: List[Tuple[int, str, str]],\n    ) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Render attributed response sections. Mechanical formatting only.\"\"\"\n        parts = []\n        for round_idx, label, text in sections:\n            parts.append(\n                f\"\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500 {label} (Round {round_idx}) \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\\n\"\n                f\"{text}\\n\"\n            )\n        return \"\\n\".join(parts)\n\n    # \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\n    # Core function 1c: Directed messaging\n    # \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\n\n    # Patterns that models can use to direct messages to specific peers.\n    # The brain matches these mechanically \u2014 it does not evaluate content.\n    _DIRECTED_PATTERNS = [\n        # @ModelName followed by content (up to end of paragraph or next @tag)\n        # Captures: (recipient, content)\n        re.compile(\n            r\"@(\\w+)\\s*[:\\-\u2014]?\\s*(.+?)(?=\\n@\\w|\\n\\n|\\Z)\",\n            re.DOTALL,\n        ),\n        # QUESTION_FOR: ModelName\\n content block\n        re.compile(\n            r\"QUESTION_FOR:\\s*(\\w+)\\s*\\n(.+?)(?=\\nQUESTION_FOR:|\\nDIRECTED:|\\nRESPONSE_TO:|\\n\\n\\n|\\Z)\",\n            re.DOTALL,\n        ),\n        # DIRECTED: ModelName: content block\n        re.compile(\n            r\"DIRECTED:\\s*(\\w+)\\s*[:\\-\u2014]\\s*(.+?)(?=\\nQUESTION_FOR:|\\nDIRECTED:|\\nRESPONSE_TO:|\\n\\n\\n|\\Z)\",\n            re.DOTALL,\n        ),\n        # RESPONSE_TO: ModelName content block\n        re.compile(\n            r\"RESPONSE_TO:\\s*(\\w+)\\s*[:\\-\u2014]?\\s*(.+?)(?=\\nQUESTION_FOR:|\\nDIRECTED:|\\nRESPONSE_TO:|\\n\\n\\n|\\Z)\",\n            re.DOTALL,\n        ),\n    ]\n\n    # Maps pattern index to message_type\n    _PATTERN_TYPE_MAP = {\n        0: \"question\",    # @tag \u2014 default to question (most common use case)\n        1: \"question\",    # QUESTION_FOR\n        2: \"challenge\",   # DIRECTED \u2014 generic directed, default challenge\n        3: \"response\",    # RESPONSE_TO\n    }\n\n    def extract_directed_messages(\n        self,\n        model_label: str,\n        response_text: str,\n        round_idx: int,\n    ) -> List[DirectedMessage]:\n        \"\"\"Extract directed messages from a model's response text.\n\n        Mechanical pattern-matching only. Matches @tags, QUESTION_FOR:,\n        DIRECTED:, and RESPONSE_TO: blocks.\n\n        Rules:\n        - Self-directed messages (sender == recipient) are discarded.\n        - Unknown model names (not in active_models) are discarded.\n        - Duplicate recipient+content pairs within a round are deduped.\n\n        Returns list of DirectedMessages, stored in state.directed_messages.\n        \"\"\"\n        messages: List[DirectedMessage] = []\n        seen: set[Tuple[str, str]] = set()  # (recipient, content_hash)\n        active = set(self.state.active_models)\n\n        for pat_idx, pattern in enumerate(self._DIRECTED_PATTERNS):\n            for match in pattern.finditer(response_text):\n                recipient_raw = match.group(1).strip()\n                content = match.group(2).strip()\n\n                # Strip leading separator punctuation that leaked into content\n                content = content.lstrip(\":\u2014- \\t\")\n\n                if not content:\n                    continue\n\n                # Resolve recipient \u2014 case-insensitive match against active models\n                recipient = self._resolve_model_name(recipient_raw, active)\n                if recipient is None:\n                    continue\n\n                # Skip self-directed messages\n                if recipient == model_label:\n                    continue\n\n                # Dedup within this extraction\n                content_key = (recipient, content[:200])\n                if content_key in seen:\n                    continue\n                seen.add(content_key)\n\n                msg_type = self._PATTERN_TYPE_MAP.get(pat_idx, \"extension\")\n                messages.append(DirectedMessage(\n                    sender=model_label,\n                    recipient=recipient,\n                    content=content,\n                    round_idx=round_idx,\n                    message_type=msg_type,\n                ))\n\n        # Store in brain state\n        self.state.directed_messages.extend(messages)\n\n        if messages:\n            logger.info(\n                \"Extracted %d directed messages from %s (round %d): %s\",\n                len(messages), model_label, round_idx,\n                \", \".join(f\"{m.recipient}({m.message_type})\" for m in messages),\n            )\n\n        return messages\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def _resolve_model_name(\n        raw_name: str,\n        active_models: set[str],\n    ) -> Optional[str]:\n        \"\"\"Resolve a raw model name to an active model label.\n\n        Case-insensitive match. Returns None if no match found.\n        \"\"\"\n        # Exact match first\n        if raw_name in active_models:\n            return raw_name\n\n        # Case-insensitive match\n        lower_map = {m.lower(): m for m in active_models}\n        if raw_name.lower() in lower_map:\n            return lower_map[raw_name.lower()]\n\n        return None\n\n    def relay_directed(self, round_idx: int) -> Dict[str, RelayPayload]:\n        \"\"\"Prepare relay payloads with directed message priority injection.\n\n        Like relay_conversational(), but:\n        1. Directed messages TO a model appear first with ADDRESSED TO YOU header\n        2. Budget priority: directed > own prior > latest round broadcast > older\n        3. Models with no directed messages get standard conversational relay\n\n        This is the recommended relay mode once models are aware of @tagging.\n        \"\"\"\n        payloads: Dict[str, RelayPayload] = {}\n\n        for model_label in self.state.active_models:\n            text, context_reset = self._format_responses_with_directed(\n                model_label, round_idx,\n            )\n\n            if round_idx > 0:\n                try:\n                    kappa = self.conv_detector.kappa(round_idx - 1)\n                    conv_summary = f\"Convergence: kappa={kappa:.3f} (threshold={self.config.tau_kappa})\"\n                except Exception:\n                    conv_summary = \"Convergence: insufficient data\"\n            else:\n                conv_summary = \"Round 0: blind round (no prior data)\"\n\n            total_findings = sum(len(rnd) for rnd in self.state.all_findings)\n\n            payloads[model_label] = RelayPayload(\n                model_label=model_label,\n                round_idx=round_idx,\n                findings_text=text,\n                finding_count=total_findings,\n                context_reset=context_reset,\n                convergence_summary=conv_summary,\n                active_models=list(self.state.active_models),\n            )\n\n        logger.info(\n            \"Directed relay for round %d: %d models\",\n            round_idx, len(payloads),\n        )\n        return payloads\n\n    def _format_responses_with_directed(\n        self,\n        model_label: str,\n        round_idx: int,\n    ) -> Tuple[str, bool]:\n        \"\"\"Format context with directed message priority injection.\n\n        Priority order (highest to lowest):\n        1. Directed messages addressed to this model\n        2. Broadcast: other models' responses (latest round first)\n        3. Broadcast: older rounds\n\n        Budget allocation: directed messages get first claim on budget.\n        Broadcast fills the remainder.\n        \"\"\"\n        if not self.state.round_records and not self.state.directed_messages:\n            return \"\", False\n\n        budget = self.config.context_budget_overrides.get(\n            model_label, self.config.context_budget_chars,\n        )\n\n        # \u2500\u2500 Priority 1: Directed messages to this model (last round only) \u2500\u2500\n        # Only inject messages from the immediately preceding round to prevent\n        # unbounded accumulation. Historical messages remain in state for\n        # diagnostics via get_directed_messages_for_model().\n        current_round = self.state.current_round\n        directed_to_me = [\n            m for m in self.state.directed_messages\n            if m.recipient == model_label and m.round_idx >= current_round - 1\n        ]\n        directed_text = \"\"\n        if directed_to_me:\n            directed_text = self._render_directed_messages(directed_to_me)\n            # Truncate directed text if it alone exceeds budget\n            if len(directed_text) > budget:\n                directed_text = directed_text[:max(0, budget - 80)] + (\n                    \"\\n\\n[TRUNCATED: directed messages exceed context budget]\"\n                )\n\n        # Reserve budget for directed messages (they get first claim)\n        directed_cost = len(directed_text)\n        broadcast_budget = max(0, budget - directed_cost)\n\n        # \u2500\u2500 Priority 2+3: Broadcast (other models' responses) \u2500\u2500\n        broadcast_text = \"\"\n        context_reset = False\n        if self.state.round_records:\n            broadcast_text, context_reset = self._format_broadcast_within_budget(\n                model_label, broadcast_budget,\n            )\n\n        # Assemble final text: directed first, then broadcast\n        parts = []\n        if directed_text:\n            parts.append(directed_text)\n        if broadcast_text:\n            parts.append(broadcast_text)\n\n        return \"\\n\\n\".join(parts), context_reset\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def _render_directed_messages(messages: List[DirectedMessage]) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Render directed messages with ADDRESSED TO YOU header.\"\"\"\n        if not messages:\n \"\u2554\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2557\",\n Never modified after creation.\n    \"\"\"\n    round_idx: int\n    timestamp: str\n    model_responses: Dict[str, str]      # model_label \u2192 raw output text\n    findings: List[Finding]              # parsed findings from all models\n    finding_count: int\n    immune_response: Optional[Any] = None  # ImmuneResponse if pipeline ran\n    metrics: Dict[str, float] = field(default_factory=dict)\n    failures: Dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)\n    duration_s: float = 0.0\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass DirectedMessage:\n    \"\"\"A directed inter-model message extracted from response text.\n\n    The brain extracts these mechanically by pattern-matching @tags,\n    QUESTION_FOR:, DIRECTED:, and RESPONSE_TO: blocks. It does not\n    evaluate the content \u2014 it routes it.\n    \"\"\"\n    sender: str              # model_label of the sender\n    recipient: str           # model_label of the intended recipient\n    content: str             # the message body\n    round_idx: int           # round in which the message was produced\n    message_type: str        # question | challenge | response | extension\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass BrainState:\n    \"\"\"Current state of the insect brain. Minimal working memory.\n\n    The brain holds only what it needs for the current operation:\n    pointers to external storage, current metrics, and active model list.\n    Full history lives in the persistence layer, not here.\n    \"\"\"\n    current_round: int = 0\n    all_findings: List[List[Finding]] = field(default_factory=list)\n    round_records: List[RoundRecord] = field(default_factory=list)\n    active_models: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)\n    directed_messages: List[DirectedMessage] = field(default_factory=list)\n    converged: bool = False\n    convergence_reason: str = \"\"\n    failed: bool = False\n    failure_reason: str = \"\"\n\n\n# \u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\n# Insect Brain\n# \u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\n\nclass InsectBrain:\n    \"\"\"Reactive mechanical relay for multi-model CDSFL coordination.\n\n    The brain is the nervous system connecting models, not the consciousness\n    directing them. It moves information and tracks metrics. It does not\n    evaluate content or direct conversation.\n\n    Usage::\n\n        brain = InsectBrain(\n            config=dm_config,\n            logs_dir=Path(\"bench/logs/exp29\"),\n            source_paths=[\"bench/immune_agents.py\"],\n        )\n        brain.initialise(model_labels=[\"CC2\", \"Gemini\", \"DeepSeek\", \"Codex\", \"ChatGPT\"])\n\n        for round_idx in range(max_rounds):\n            # Get relay payloads for each model\n            payloads = brain.relay(round_idx)\n\n            # Dispatch models (external \u2014 brain doesn't call models)\n            responses = dispatch_models(payloads)\n\n            # Feed results back to brain\n            findings = parse_findings(responses)\n            brain.persist(round_idx, responses, findings)\n\n            # Run immune pipeline\n            immune_result = brain.run_immune_pipeline(findings)\n\n            # Check convergence\n            if brain.check_convergence(round_idx):\n                brain.signal_complete()\n                break\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(\n        self,\n        config: DynamicManagementConfig,\n        logs_dir: Path,\n        source_paths: List[str],\n        convergence_detector: Optional[ConvergenceDetector] = None,\n    ):\n        self.config = config\n        self.logs_dir = Path(logs_dir)\n        self.source_paths = source_paths\n        self.state = BrainState()\n\n        # Convergence detector \u2014 reuse existing implementation\n        self.conv_detector = convergence_detector or ConvergenceDetector(config)\n\n        # Ensure logs directory exists\n        self.logs_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n\n    def initialise(self, model_labels: List[str]) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Set up the brain for a new experiment run.\n\n        Args:\n            model_labels: Labels of all participating models.\n        \"\"\"\n        self.state = BrainState(\n            active_models=list(model_labels),\n        )\n        logger.info(\n            \"Insect brain initialised: %d models, logs at %s\",\n            len(model_labels), self.logs_dir,\n        )\n\n    # \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\n    # Core function 1: relay()\n    # \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\n\n    def relay(self, round_idx: int) -> Dict[str, RelayPayload]:\n        \"\"\"Prepare relay payloads for each active model.\n\n        Mechanical formatting only \u2014 no editorial changes to findings.\n        Each model receives other models' findings (cross-pollination),\n        constrained by the per-model context budget.\n\n        Returns dict of model_label \u2192 RelayPayload.\n        \"\"\"\n        payloads: Dict[str, RelayPayload] = {}\n\n        for model_label in self.state.active_models:\n            findings_text, context_reset = self._format_findings_for_model(\n                model_label, round_idx,\n            )\n\n            # Convergence summary (one line, mechanical)\n            if round_idx > 0:\n                try:\n                    kappa = self.conv_detector.kappa(round_idx - 1)\n                    conv_summary = f\"Convergence: kappa={kappa:.3f} (threshold={self.config.tau_kappa})\"\n                except Exception:\n                    conv_summary = \"Convergence: insufficient data\"\n            else:\n                conv_summary = \"Round 0: blind round (no prior data)\"\n\n            total_findings = sum(len(rnd) for rnd in self.state.all_findings)\n\n            payloads[model_label] = RelayPayload(\n                model_label=model_label,\n                round_idx=round_idx,\n                findings_text=findings_text,\n                finding_count=total_findings,\n                context_reset=context_reset,\n                convergence_summary=conv_summary,\n                active_models=list(self.state.active_models),\n            )\n\n        logger.info(\n            \"Relay prepared for round %d: %d models, %d total findings\",\n            round_idx, len(payloads),\n            sum(len(rnd) for rnd in self.state.all_findings),\n        )\n        return payloads\n\n    def _format_findings_for_model(\n        self,\n        model_label: str,\n        round_idx: int,\n    ) -> Tuple[str, bool]:\n        \"\"\"Format prior findings for a specific model.\n\n        Cross-pollination: exclude model's own findings.\n        Budget-aware: switch to summary-only if over budget.\n\n        Returns (formatted_text, context_reset_flag).\n        \"\"\"\n        if not self.state.all_findings:\n            return \"\", False\n\n        # Budget for this model\n        budget = self.config.context_budget_overrides.get(\n            model_label, self.config.context_budget_chars,\n        )\n\n        # Cross-pollination: other models' findings only\n        cross_findings: List[Finding] = []\n        for rnd in self.state.all_findings:\n            for f in rnd:\n                if f.model_id != model_label:\n                    cross_findings.append(f)\n\n        if not cross_findings:\n            return \"\", False\n\n        # Try full format first\n        full_text = self._format_findings_full(cross_findings)\n        if len(full_text) <= budget:\n            return full_text, False\n\n        # Over budget \u2014 try last round only\n        if self.state.all_findings:\n            last_round = [\n                f for f in self.state.all_findings[-1]\n                if f.model_id != model_label\n            ]\n            last_text = self._format_findings_full(last_round)\n            if len(last_text) <= budget:\n                header = (\n                    f\"(CONTEXT BUDGET: showing last round only. \"\n                    f\"{len(cross_findings)} total prior findings exist.)\\n\\n\"\n                )\n                return header + last_text, False\n\n        # Still over \u2014 summary-only mode (context reset)\n        summary = self._format_findings_summary(cross_findings)\n        return summary, True\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def _format_findings_full(findings: List[Finding]) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Format findings as full text. Mechanical \u2014 no editorial changes.\"\"\"\n        lines = []\n        for f in findings:\n            lines.append(\n                f\"[{f.finding_id}] model={f.model_id} round={f.round_idx} \"\n                f\"severity={f.severity:.2f}\\n\"\n                f\"  {f.description}\\n\"\n                f\"  Fix: {f.proposed_fix}\\n\"\n            )\n        return \"\\n\".join(lines)\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def _format_findings_summary(findings: List[Finding]) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Format findings as summary only (ID + severity + one line).\n\n        Used when full text exceeds context budget. This is a context reset.\n        Findings with accepted fixes are marked CLOSED \u2014 models must not\n        relitigate these. First sufficient fix wins (Occam's razor).\n        \"\"\"\n        # CLOSED = fix exists AND programmatically verified (tools passed)\n        closed = [f for f in findings if f.proposed_fix.strip() and f.verified]\n        # ESCALATED = no programmatic fix possible, awaiting human decision\n        escalated = [f for f in findings if f.escalated and not f.verified]\n        # PENDING = fix proposed but not yet verified by tools\n        pending = [f for f in findings\n                   if f.proposed_fix.strip() and not f.verified and not f.escalated]\n        # OPEN = no fix proposed, not escalated\n        open_findings = [f for f in findings\n                         if not f.proposed_fix.strip() and not f.escalated and not f.verified]\n\n        lines = []\n        lines.append(\n            f\"(CONTEXT RESET: {len(findings)} prior findings exist. \"\n            f\"{len(closed)} CLOSED, {len(escalated)} ESCALATED, \"\n            f\"{len(pending)} PENDING, {len(open_findings)} OPEN. \"\n            f\"Do NOT relitigate CLOSED or ESCALATED bugs. \"\n            f\"Find NEW issues only.)\\n\"\n        )\n\n        if closed:\n            lines.append(\"\u2500\u2500 CLOSED (verified fix \u2014 do not relitigate) \u2500\u2500\")\n            for f in closed:\n                desc_clean = f.description.replace(\"\\n\", \" \")\n                desc_short = desc_clean[:57] + \"...\" if len(desc_clean) > 60 else desc_clean\n                lines.append(\n                    f\"  [CLOSED] {f.finding_id} (sev={f.severity:.2f}): {desc_short}\"\n                )\n            lines.append(\"\")\n\n        if escalated:\n            lines.append(\"\u2500\u2500 ESCALATED (awaiting human decision \u2014 do not attempt to fix) \u2500\u2500\")\n            for f in escalated:\n                desc_clean = f.description.replace(\"\\n\", \" \")\n                desc_short = desc_clean[:57] + \"...\" if len(desc_clean) > 60 else desc_clean\n                lines.append(\n                    f\"  [ESCALATED] {f.finding_id} (sev={f.severity:.2f}): {desc_short}\"\n                )\n            lines.append(\"\")\n\n        if pending:\n            lines.append(\"\u2500\u2500 PENDING (fix proposed, awaiting tool verification) \u2500\u2500\")\n            for f in pending:\n                desc_clean = f.description.replace(\"\\n\", \" \")\n                desc_short = desc_clean[:67] + \"...\" if len(desc_clean) > 70 else desc_clean\n                lines.append(\n                    f\"  [PENDING] {f.finding_id} (sev={f.severity:.2f}): {desc_short}\"\n                )\n            lines.append(\"\")\n\n        if open_findings:\n            lines.append(\"\u2500\u2500 OPEN (no fix yet \u2014 contributions welcome) \u2500\u2500\")\n            for f in open_findings:\n                desc_clean = f.description.replace(\"\\n\", \" \")\n                desc_short = desc_clean[:77] + \"...\" if len(desc_clean) > 80 else desc_clean\n                lines.append(\n                    f\"  {f.finding_id} (sev={f.severity:.2f}): {desc_short}\"\n                )\n\n        return \"\\n\".join(lines)\n\n    #    # Core function 1b: relay_conversational()\n    # \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\n\n    def relay_conversational(self, round_idx: int) -> Dict[str, RelayPayload]:\n        \"\"\"Prepare conversational relay payloads \u2014 full model responses.\n\n        Like relay(), but passes raw response text from other models instead\n        of parsed findings. Models see each other's full FFF reasoning chains,\n        not just the extracted conclusions.\n\n        Still mechanical: no editorial changes. Budget-constrained per model.\n        Cross-pollination: each model sees other models' responses only.\n        \"\"\"\n        payloads: Dict[str, RelayPayload] = {}\n\n        for model_label in try:\n                    kappa = self.conv_detector.kappa(round_idx - 1)\n                    conv_summary = f\"Convergence: kappa={kappa:.3f} (threshold={self.config.tau_kappa})\"\n                except Exception:\n                    conv_summary = \"Convergence: insufficient data\"\n            else:\n                conv_summary = \"Round 0: blind round (no prior data)\"\n\n            total_findings = sum(len(rnd) for rnd in self.state.all_findings)\n\n            payloads[model_label] = RelayPayload(\n                model_label=model_label,\n                round_idx=round_idx,\n                findings_text=text,\n                finding_count=total_findings,\n                context_reset=context_reset,\n                convergence_summary=conv_summary,\n                active_models=list(self.state.active_models),\n            )\n\n        logger.info(\n            \"Conversational relay for round %d: %d models\",\n            round_idx, len(payloads),\n        )\n        return payloads\n\n    def _format_responses_for_model(\n        self,\n        model_label: str,\n        round_idx: int,\n    ) -> Tuple[str, bool]:\n        \"\"\"Format other models' full responses for a specific model.\n\n        Cross-pollination: exclude model's own responses.\n        Budget-aware: degrade gracefully when over budget.\n        Degradation ladder: full text \u2192 last round only \u2192 findings summary.\n        \"\"\"\n        if not self.state.round_records:\n            return \"\", False\n\n        budget = self.config.context_budget_overrides.get(\n            model_label, self.config.context_budget_chars,\n        )\n\n        # Collect all other models' responses, attributed\n        all_sections: List[Tuple[int, str, str]] = []  # (round, label, text)\n        for record in self.state.round_records:\n            for resp_label, resp_text in record.model_responses.items():\n                if resp_label != model_label and resp_text:\n                    all_sections.append((record.round_idx, resp_label, resp_text))\n\n        if not all_sections:\n            return \"\", False\n\n        # Try full responses\n        full_text = self._render_response_sections(all_sections)\n        if len(full_text) <= budget:\n            return full_text, False\n\n        # Over budget \u2014 last round only\n        last_round_idx = self.state.round_records[-1].round_idx\n        last_sections = [(r, label, txt) for r, label, txt in all_sections if r == last_round_idx]\n        last_text = self._render_response_sections(last_sections)\n\n        if len(last_text) <= budget:\n            n_earlier = len(all_sections) - len(last_sections)\n            header = (\n                f\"(CONTEXT BUDGET: showing last round responses only. \"\n                f\"{n_earlier} earlier responses from other models exist.)\\n\\n\"\n            )\n            return header + last_text, False\n\n        # Still over \u2014 fall back to findings summary (context reset)\n        cross_findings: List[Finding] = []\n        for rnd in self.state.all_findings:\n            for f in rnd:\n                if f.model_id != model_label:\n                    cross_findings.append(f)\n        return self._format_findings_summary(cross_findings), True\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def _render_response_sections(\n        sections: List[Tuple[int, str, str]],\n    ) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Render attributed response sections. Mechanical formatting only.\"\"\"\n        parts = []\n        for round_idx, label, text in sections:\n            parts.append(\n                f\"\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500 {label} (Round {round_idx}) \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\\n\"\n                f\"{text}\\n\"\n            )\n        return \"\\n\".join(parts)\n\n    # \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\n    # Core function 1c: Directed messaging\n    # \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\n\n    # Patterns that models can use to direct messages to specific peers.\n    # The brain matches these mechanically \u2014 it does not evaluate content.\n    _DIRECTED_PATTERNS = [\n        # @ModelName followed by content (up to end of paragraph or next @tag)\n        # Captures: (recipient, content)\n        re.compile(\n            r\"@(\\w+)\\s*[:\\-\u2014]?\\s*(.+?)(?=\\n@\\w|\\n\\n|\\Z)\",\n            re.DOTALL,\n        ),\n        # QUESTION_FOR: ModelName\\n content block\n        re.compile(\n            r\"QUESTION_FOR:\\s*(\\w+)\\s*\\n(.+?)(?=\\nQUESTION_FOR:|\\nDIRECTED:|\\nRESPONSE_TO:|\\n\\n\\n|\\Z)\",\n            re.DOTALL,\n        ),\n        # DIRECTED: ModelName: content block\n        re.compile(\n            r\"DIRECTED:\\s*(\\w+)\\s*[:\\-\u2014]\\s*(.+?)(?=\\nQUESTION_FOR:|\\nDIRECTED:|\\nRESPONSE_TO:|\\n\\n\\n|\\Z)\",\n            re.DOTALL,\n        ),\n        # RESPONSE_TO: ModelName content block\n        re.compile(\n            r\"RESPONSE_TO:\\s*(\\w+)\\s*[:\\-\u2014]?\\s*(.+?)(?=\\nQUESTION_FOR:|\\nDIRECTED:|\\nRESPONSE_TO:|\\n\\n\\n|\\Z)\",\n            re.DOTALL,\n        ),\n    ]\n\n    # Maps pattern index to message_type\n    _PATTERN_TYPE_MAP = {\n        0: \"question\",    # @tag \u2014 default to question (most common use case)\n        1: \"question\",    # QUESTION_FOR\n        2: \"challenge\",   # DIRECTED \u2014 generic directed, default challenge\n        3: \"response\",    # RESPONSE_TO\n    }\n\n    def extract_directed_messages(\n        self,\n        model_label: str,\n        response_text: str,\n        round_idx: int,\n    ) -> List[DirectedMessage]:\n        \"\"\"Extract directed messages from a model's response text.\n\n        Mechanical pattern-matching only. Matches @tags, QUESTION_FOR:,\n        DIRECTED:, and RESPONSE_TO: blocks.\n\n        Rules:\n        - Self-directed messages (sender == recipient) are discarded.\n        - Unknown model names (not in active_models) are discarded.\n        - Duplicate recipient+content pairs within a round are deduped.\n\n        Returns list of DirectedMessages, stored in state.directed_messages.\n        \"\"\"\n        messages: List[DirectedMessage] = []\n        seen: set[Tuple[str, str]] = set()  # (recipient, content_hash)\n        active = set(self.state.active_models)\n\n        for pat_idx, pattern in enumerate(self._DIRECTED_PATTERNS):\n            for match in pattern.finditer(response_text):\n                recipient_raw = match.group(1).strip()\n                content = match.group(2).strip()\n\n                # Strip leading separator punctuation that leaked into content\n                content = content.lstrip(\":\u2014- \\t\")\n\n                if not content:\n                    continue\n\n                #
