already has a programmatically verified fix, this bug is closed.\n            matched_pf = next(\n                (pf for pf in prior_findings if pf.finding_id == best_match),\n                None,\n            )\n            has_fix = (\n                matched_pf is not None\n                and bool(matched_pf.proposed_fix.strip())\n                and matched_pf.verified\n            )\n            is_escalated = (\n                matched_pf is not None\n                and matched_pf.escalated\n            )\n            tf.is_duplicate = True\n            tf.duplicate_of = best_match\n            tf.similarity = best_sim\n            if has_fix:\n                _evidence = f\"Bug CLOSED \u2014 dup of {best_match} (sim={best_sim:.3f}), fix exists\"\n                _tool = \"bug_closed\"\n            elif is_escalated:\n                _evidence = f\"Bug ESCALATED \u2014 dup of {best_match} (sim={best_sim:.3f}), awaiting HIL\"\n                _tool = \"escalated\"\n            else:\n                _evidence = f\"Duplicate of {best_match} (sim={best_sim:.3f})\"\n                _tool = \"similarity_dedup\"\n            verdicts.append(CellVerdict(\n                cell_type=CellType.NK_CELL,\n                finding_id=f.finding_id,\n                verdict=\"DUPLICATE\",\n                confidence=best_sim,\n                evidence=_evidence,\n                tool_used=_tool,\n            ))\n            continue\n\n        # 2. Check against known false-positive patterns\n        # Bug#10 fix: track FP match to skip anomaly detection (v1 control flow leak)\n        is_fp = False\n        for fp in fp_db:\n            if fp[\"pattern\"].search(f.description):\n                model_match = (\n                    not fp.get(\"expected_model\")\n                    or fp[\"expected_model\"] == f.model_id\n                )\n                if model_match:\n                    verdicts.append(CellVerdict(\n                        cell_type=CellType.NK_CELL,\n                        finding_id=f.finding_id,\n                        verdict=\"REJECTED\",\n                        confidence=0.90,\n                        evidence=f\"Known FP: {fp['source']}\",\n                        tool_used=\"false_positive_db\",\n                    ))\n                    is_fp = True\n                    break\n\n        if is_fp:\n            continue  # Bug#10 fix: skip anomaly detection for known FPs\n\n        # 3. Anomaly detection: severity outliers\n        # MF-17 fix: emit REJECTED (not UNCERTAIN) for anomalous findings\n        if f.severity > 0.95 and f.round_idx > 5:\n            verdicts.append(CellVerdict(\n                cell_type=CellType.NK_CELL,\n                finding_id=f.finding_id,\n                verdict=\"REJECTED\",\n                confidence=0.6,\n                evidence=f\"Late-round high severity ({f.severity:.2f} at R{f.round_idx}) \u2014 possible inflation\",\n                tool_used=\"anomaly_detection\",\n            ))\n\n    return triaged, verdicts\n\n\n# \u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\n# 5. HELPER T-CELL \u2014 Verdict synthesis\n# \u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\n\ndef helper_t_cell_synthesize(\n    triaged: List[TriagedFinding],\n    all_verdicts: List[CellVerdict],\n) -> Tuple[Dict[str, str], Dict[str, float]]:\n    \"\"\"Stage 3a: Synthesize all cell verdicts into final judgments.\n\n    The Helper T-Cell coordinates the immune response by aggregating\n    verdicts from all cell types. Uses confidence-weighted voting:\n    - CONFIRMED verdicts contribute positive weight\n    - REJECTED verdicts contribute negative weight\n    - UNCERTAIN verdicts contribute nothing\n    - DUPLICATE verdicts are auto-rejected\n\n    A finding needs net positive confidence to survive.\n    Asymmetric threshold: rejection requires 0.6+ net confidence,\n    confirmation requires only 0.4+ (false negatives are costlier\n    than false positives).\n    \"\"\"\n    # Group verdicts by finding \u2014 MF-11 fix: deduplicate by cell type\n    # (keep highest-confidence verdict per cell type per finding)\n    verdicts_by_finding: Dict[str, List[CellVerdict]] = {}\n    for v in all_verdicts:\n        verdicts_by_finding.setdefault(v.finding_id, []).append(v)\n\n    # Deduplicate: one verdict per cell type per finding\n    for fid in verdicts_by_finding:\n        seen_cells: Dict[CellType, CellVerdict] = {}\n        for v in verdicts_by_finding[fid]:\n            if v.cell_type not in seen_cells or v.confidence > seen_cells[v.cell_type].confidence:\n                seen_cells[v.cell_type] = v\n        verdicts_by_finding[fid] = list(seen_cells.values())\n\n    final_verdicts: Dict[str, str] = {}\n    final_confidences: Dict[str, float] = {}\n\n    for tf in triaged:\n        fid = tf.finding.finding_id\n        fv = verdicts_by_finding.get(fid, [])\n\n        # Auto-reject duplicates\n        if tf.is_duplicate:\n            final_verdicts[fid] = \"DUPLICATE\"\n            final_confidences[fid] = tf.similarity\n            continue\n\n        # Confidence-weighted voting\n        confirm_weight = 0.0\n        reject_weight = 0.0\n\n        for v in fv:\n            if v.verdict == \"CONFIRMED\":\n                confirm_weight += v.confidence\n            elif v.verdict == \"REJECTED\":\n                reject_weight += v.confidence\n            elif v.verdict == \"DUPLICATE\":\n                reject_weight += v.confidence\n            # UNCERTAIN contributes nothing\n\n        total = confirm_weight + reject_weight\n        if total == 0:\n            # No verdicts \u2014 pass through (precautionary principle)\n            final_verdicts[fid] = \"UNCERTAIN\"\n            final_confidences[fid] = 0.0\n        elif reject_weight / max(total, 0.001) >= 0.6:\n            final_verdicts[fid] = \"REJECTED\"\n            # MF-09 fix: cap confidence by max individual verdict weight\n            max_individual = max((v.confidence for v in fv if v.verdict in (\"REJECTED\", \"DUPLICATE\")), default=0.0)\n            final_confidences[fid] = min(reject_weight / total, max_individual)\n        elif confirm_weight / max(total, 0.001) >= 0.4:\n            final_verdicts[fid] = \"CONFIRMED\"\n            # MF-09 fix: cap confidence by max individual verdict weight\n            max_individual = max((v.confidence for v in fv if v.verdict == \"CONFIRMED\"), default=0.0)\n            final_confidences[fid] = min(confirm_weight / total, max_individual)\n        else:\n            final_verdicts[fid] = \"UNCERTAIN\"\n            final_confidences[fid] = max(confirm_weight, reject_weight) / max(total, 0.001)\n\n    return final_verdicts, final_confidences\n\n\n# \u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\n# 6. REGULATORY T-CELL \u2014 Meta-verification and autoimmune prevention\n# \u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\n\ndef regulatory_t_cell_check(\n    final_verdicts: Dict[str, str],\n    triaged: List[TriagedFinding],\n    max_rejection_rate: float = 0.65,\n    min_findings_for_check: int = 5,\n) -> Tuple[bool, str]:\n    \"\"\"Stage 3b: Check for autoimmune response (over-rejection).\n\n    The Regulatory T-Cell prevents the immune system from attacking\n    valid findings. If the rejection rate exceeds the threshold,\n    it flags an autoimmune condition \u2014 the verification pipeline\n    itself may be miscalibrated.\n\n    Returns:\n        (autoimmune_flag, reason)\n    \"\"\"\n    total = len(final_verdicts)\n    if total < min_findings_for_check:\n        return False, f\"Too few findings ({total}) for meta-check\"\n\n    rejected = sum(1 for v in final_verdicts.values() if v == \"REJECTED\")\n    duplicated = sum(1 for v in final_verdicts.values() if v == \"DUPLICATE\")\n    removed = rejected + duplicated\n    removal_rate = removed / total\n\n    reasons = []\n\n    # Check 1: Overall rejection rate\n    if rejected / total > max_rejection_rate:\n        reasons.append(\n            f\"Rejection rate {rejected}/{total} ({rejected/total:.1%}) \"\n            f\"exceeds threshold ({max_rejection_rate:.0%})\"\n        )\n\n    # Check 1b (MF-36 fix): High UNCERTAIN rate indicates fail-open illusion\n    uncertain = sum(1 for v in final_verdicts.values() if v == \"UNCERTAIN\")\n    uncertain_rate = uncertain / total\n    if uncertain_rate > 0.30:\n        reasons.append(\n            f\"UNCERTAIN rate {uncertain}/{total} ({uncertain_rate:.1%}) \"\n            f\"exceeds 30% \u2014 verification tools may be non-functional (fail-open)\"\n        )\n\n    # Check 2: Single cell type dominating rejections\n    # (indicates a miscalibrated tool, not genuine false positives)\n    # We'd need per-cell rejection counts here \u2014 tracked via verdicts\n\n    # Check 3: All findings from one model rejected\n    model_counts: Dict[str, int] = {}\n    model_rejected: Dict[str, int] = {}\n    for tf in triaged:\n        mid = tf.finding.model_id\n        model_counts[mid] = model_counts.get(mid, 0) + 1\n        if final_verdicts.get(tf.finding.finding_id) == \"REJECTED\":\n            model_rejected[mid] = model_rejected.get(mid, 0) + 1\n\n    for mid, total_m in model_counts.items():\n        rej_m = model_rejected.get(mid, 0)\n        if total_m >= 3 and rej_m == total_m:\n            reasons.append(\n                f\"All {total_m} findings from {mid} rejected \u2014 \"\n                f\"possible systematic bias against this model\"\n            )\n\n    if reasons:\n        return True, \"; \".join(reasons)\n\n    return False, f\"Pipeline healthy: {removal_rate:.1%} removal rate\"\n\n\n# \u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\n# ORCHESTRATOR \u2014 Run the full immune pipeline\n# \u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\n\n# V2 IMMUNE COMPONENTS (activated WP6a, Exp 29)\n#\n# These implement architectural improvements from the Gemini CDSFL\n# conversation (3 April 2026). All v2 components are now active in the\n# pipeline. DC v2, NK v2, Reg T v2 are PRIMARY. CT v2, B-Cell v2 run\n# in parallel with v1. Shadow logging captures v1-vs-v2 comparison data.\n# \u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\n\nimport logging as _logging\nimport threading as _threading\n\n# Bug#4 fix: serialise claude CLI calls to prevent contention\n_CLAUDE_CLI_LOCK = _threading.Lock()\n\n_shadow_log = _logging.getLogger(\"immune.shadow\")\n\n# Configure shadow logger to write to file if not already configured.\n# This ensures v1-vs-v2 comparison data, formalisation agent output,\n# and typed LLM classifier results are persisted for analysis.\nif not _shadow_log.handlers:\n    _shadow_log.setLevel(_logging.INFO)\n    import os as _os\n    # Bug#20 fix: removed dead first assignment\n    _shadow_log_dir = _os.path.join(\n        _os.path.dirname(_os.path.abspath(__file__)), \"logs\"\n    )\n    _os.makedirs(_shadow_log_dir, exist_ok=True)\n    _shadow_fh = _logging.FileHandler(\n        _os.path.join(_shadow_log_dir, \"immune_shadow.log\"),\n        encoding=\"utf-8\",\n    )\n    _shadow_fh.setLevel(_logging.INFO)\n    _shadow_fh.setFormatter(_logging.Formatter(\n        \"%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(message)s\", datefmt=\"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S\"\n    ))\n    _shadow_log.addHandler(_shadow_fh)\n\n\n# \u2500\u2500 0. SKIN BARRIER \u2014 deterministic pre-filter \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\n#\n# Runs BEFORE the pipeline. Checks whether a finding's code citations\n# actually exist in the source files. A finding that cites code that isn't\n# there is likely hallucinated. In active mode, these would be dropped\n# before reaching the Dendritic Cell.\n\n@dataclass\nclass SkinBarrierResult:\n    \"\"\"Result of skin barrier check for a single finding.\"\"\"\n    finding_id: str\n    passed: bool\n    reason: str\n    cited_file: str = \"\"\n    cited_line: int = 0\n\n\ndef skin_barrier_check(\n    findings: List[Finding],\n    source_paths: List[str],\n) -> Tuple[List[Finding], List[SkinBarrierResult]]:\n    \"\"\"Deterministic pre-filter: verify that cited code exists.\n\n    Checks each finding for file:line citations. If the cited code doesn't\n    exist at the cited location, the finding fails the barrier.\n\n    In shadow mode (Run 11), all findings pass through regardless.\n    The results are logged for observation.\n\n    Returns:\n        (all_findings, barrier_results) \u2014 findings unchanged in shadow mode\n    \"\"\"\n    results: List[SkinBarrierResult] = []\n    source_set = set(str(p) for p in source_paths)\n\n    # Also build a set of relative paths and basenames for fuzzy matching\n    # Bug#69 fix: track ambiguous basenames (multiple paths for same name)\n    source_basenames: Dict[str, str] = {}\n    _ambiguous_basenames: Set[str] = set()\n    for p in source_paths:\n        bn = os.path.basename(str(p))\n        if bn in source_basenames:\n            _ambiguous_basenames.add(bn)\n        source_basenames[bn] = str(p)\n\n    for f in findings:\n        desc = f.description\n\n        # Extract file:line citations from the description\n        # Common patterns: \"file.py:123\", \"line 123 of file.py\",\n        # \"at line 123\", \"file.py line 123\"\n        # Bug#5 fix: match any file extension, not just .py\n        citations = re.findall(\n            r'(\\S+\\.\\w+)(?::|\\s+line\\s+)(\\d+)', desc\n        )\n        if not citations:\n            # Bug#41 fix: line-only citations cannot be verified without a file path.\n            # Pass by default rather than creating unresolvable citations.\n            pass\n\n        if not citations:\n            # No citations to check \u2014 passes by default\n            results.append(SkinBarrierResult(\n                finding_id=f.finding_id, passed=True,\n                reason=\"No file:line citation to verify\",\n            ))\n            continue\n\n        # Try basename match (Bug#69: skip if ambiguous)\n            elif (os.path.basename(cited_file_raw) in source_basenames\n                  and os.path.basename(cited_file_raw) not in _ambiguous_basenames):\n                cited_file = source_basenames[os.path.basename(cited_file_raw)]\n            # Try partial path match\n            else:\n                for sp_path in source_paths:\n                    if str(sp_path).endswith(cited_file_raw):\n                        cited_file = str(sp_path)\n                        break\n\n        if not cited_file:\n            results.append(SkinBarrierResult(\n                finding_id=f.finding_id, passed=False,\n                reason=f\"Cited file not found: {cited_file_raw}\",\n                cited_file=cited_file_raw, cited_line=cited_line,\n            ))\n            continue\n\n        # Check the file exists and the line is in range\n        if not os.path.isfile(cited_file):\n            results.append(SkinBarrierResult(\n                finding_id=f.finding_id, passed=False,\n                reason=f\"File does not exist: {cited_file}\",\n                cited_file=cited_file, cited_line=cited_line,\n            ))\n            continue\n\n        # C5-23 fix: bounded line streaming to prevent OOM on large files\n        try:\n            lines: List[str] = []\n            max_lines = 50000  # configurable limit\n            with open(cited_file, \"r\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as fh:\n                for i, line in enumerate(fh):\n                    if i >= max_lines:\n                        break\n                    lines.append(line)\n        except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError):\n            results.append(SkinBarrierResult(\n                finding_id=f.finding_id, passed=False,\n                reason=f\"Cannot read file: {cited_file}\",\n                cited_file=cited_file, cited_line=cited_line,\n            ))\n            continue\n\n        if cited_line < 1 or cited_line > len(lines):\n            results.append(SkinBarrierResult(\n                finding_id=f.finding_id, passed=False,\n                reason=f\"Line {cited_line} out of range (file has {len(lines)} lines)\",\n                cited_file=cited_file, cited_line=cited_line,\n            ))\n            continue\n\n        # Mathematical claims get SymPy,\n    logical claims get z3, statistical claims get statsmodels.\n    Cross-verification (class switching): if SymPy returns UNCERTAIN,\n    try z3 as a fallback.\n    \"\"\"\n    verdicts: List[CellVerdict] = []\n\n    for tf in triaged:\n        if tf.is_duplicate:\n            continue\n\n        fid = tf.finding.finding_id\n        v: Optional[CellVerdict] = None\n\n        if tf.claim_type == ClaimType.MATHEMATICAL:\n            v = _verify_sympy(tf.extracted_claim)\n            # Class switching: if SymPy uncertain, try z3\n            if v.verdict == \"UNCERTAIN\":\n                v2 = _verify_z3(tf.extracted_claim)\n                if v2.verdict != \"UNCERTAIN\":\n                    v = v2\n                    v.evidence += \" [class-switched from SymPy]\"\n\n        elif tf.claim_type == ClaimType.LOGICAL:\n            v = _verify_z3(tf.extracted_claim)\n\n        elif tf.claim_type == ClaimType.STATISTICAL:\n            v = _verify_statistical(tf.extracted_claim)\n\n        if v is not None:\n            v.finding_id = fid\n            verdicts.append(v)\n\n    return verdicts\n\n\n# \u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\n# 4. NK CELL \u2014 Pattern recognition, dedup, and immune memory\n# \u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\n\n# Known false-positive patterns from Run 7b analysis\n# MF-18 fix: add re.DOTALL to FP patterns for multiline descriptions\n_KNOWN_FALSE_POSITIVES: List[Dict[str, Any]] = [\n    {\n        \"pattern\": re.compile(r\"@dataclass\\s+decorator.*missing\", re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL),\n        \"source\": \"Run 7b: Codex hallucinated missing @dataclass 8 times\",\n        \"expected_model\": \"Codex\",\n    },\n    {\n        \"pattern\": re.compile(r\"missing\\s+@dataclass\", re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL),\n        \"source\": \"Run 7b: @dataclass false positive cluster\",\n        \"expected_model\": \"Codex\",\n    },\n]\n\n\ndef nk_cell_verify(\n    triaged: List[TriagedFinding],\n    prior_findings: List[Finding],\n    tau_sim: float = 0.33,  # Calibrated from Run 8: max sim 0.553 at old 0.8\n    false_positive_db: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = None,\n) -> Tuple[List[TriagedFinding], List[CellVerdict]]:\n    \"\"\"Stage 2c: Pattern recognition and deduplication.\n\n    The NK Cell provides innate-like immunity with adaptive memory.\n    It matches findings against:\n    1. MF-19: early termination\n\n        # MF-16 fix: assert best_match is not None (prevent phantom duplicates)\n        if best_sim >= tau_sim and best_match is not None:\n            # Bug-closed gate (v1 parity with v2): if matched finding\n            # already has a programmatically verified fix, this bug is closed.\n            matched_pf = next(\n                (pf for pf in prior_findings if pf.finding_id == best_match),\n                None,\n            )\n            has_fix = (\n                matched_pf is not None\n                and bool(matched_pf.proposed_fix.strip())\n                and matched_pf.verified\n            )\n            is_escalated = (\n                matched_pf is not None\n                and matched_pf.escalated\n            )\n            tf.is_duplicate = True\n            tf.duplicate_of = best_match\n            tf.similarity = best_sim\n            if has_fix:\n                _evidence = f\"Bug CLOSED \u2014 dup of {best_match} (sim={best_sim:.3f}), fix exists\"\n                _tool = \"bug_closed\"\n            elif is_escalated:\n                _evidence = f\"Bug ESCALATED \u2014 dup of {best_match} (sim={best_sim:.3f}), awaiting HIL\"\n                _tool = \"escalated\"\n            else:\n                _evidence = f\"Duplicate of {best_match} (sim={best_sim:.3f})\"\n                _tool = \"similarity_dedup\"\n            verdicts.append(CellVerdict(\n                cell_type=CellType.NK_CELL,\n                finding_id=f.finding_id,\n                verdict=\"DUPLICATE\",\n                confidence=best_sim,\n                evidence=_evidence,\n                tool_used=_tool,\n            ))\n            continue\n\n        # 2. Check against known false-positive patterns\n        # Bug#10 fix: track FP match to skip anomaly detection (v1 control flow leak)\n        is_fp = False\n        for fp in fp_db:\n            if fp[\"pattern\"].search(f.description):\n                model_match = (\n                    not fp.get(\"expected_model\")\n                    or fp[\"expected_model\"] == f.model_id\n                )\n                if model_match:\n                    verdicts.append(CellVerdict(\n                        cell_type=CellType.NK_CELL,\n                        finding_id=f.finding_id,\n                        verdict=\"REJECTED\",\n                        confidence=0.90,\n                        evidence=f\"Known FP: {fp['source']}\",\n                        tool_used=\"false_positive_db\",\n                    ))\n                    is_fp = True\n                    break\n\n        if is_fp:\n            continue  # Bug#10 fix: skip anomaly detection for known FPs\n\n        # 3. HELPER T-CELL \u2014 Verdict synthesis\n# \u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\n\ndef helper_t_cell_synthesize(\n    triaged: List[TriagedFinding],\n    all_verdicts: List[CellVerdict],\n) -> Tuple[Dict[str, str], Dict[str, float]]:\n    \"\"\"Stage 3a: Synthesize all cell verdicts into final judgments.\n\n    The Helper T-Cell coordinates the immune response by aggregating\n    verdicts from all cell types. Uses confidence-weighted voting:\n    - CONFIRMED verdicts contribute positive weight\n    - REJECTED verdicts contribute negative weight\n    - UNCERTAIN verdicts contribute nothing\n    - DUPLICATE verdicts are auto-rejected\n\n    A finding needs net positive confidence to survive.\n    Asymmetric threshold: rejection requires 0.6+ net confidence,\n    confirmation requires only 0.4+ (false negatives are costlier\n    than false positives).\n    \"\"\"\n    # This is a context reset.\n        Findings with accepted fixes are marked CLOSED \u2014 models must not\n        relitigate these. First sufficient fix wins (Occam's razor).\n        \"\"\"\n        # CLOSED = fix exists AND programmatically verified (tools passed)\n        closed = [f for f in findings if f.proposed_fix.strip() and f.verified]\n        # ESCALATED = no programmatic fix possible, awaiting human decision\n        escalated = [f for f in findings if f.escalated and not f.verified]\n        # PENDING = fix proposed but not yet verified by tools\n        pending = [f for f in findings\n                   if f.proposed_fix.strip() and not f.verified and not f.escalated]\n        # OPEN = no fix proposed, not escalated\n        open_findings = [f for f in findings\n                         if not f.proposed_fix.strip() and not f.escalated and not f.verified]\n\n        lines = []\n        lines.append(\n            f\"(CONTEXT RESET: {len(findings)} prior findings exist. \"\n            f\"{len(closed)} CLOSED, {len(escalated)} ESCALATED, \"\n            f\"{len(pending)} PENDING, {len(open_findings)} OPEN. \"\n            f\"Do NOT relitigate CLOSED or ESCALATED bugs. \"\n            f\"Find NEW issues only.)\\n\"\n        )\n\n        if closed:\n      desc_short = desc_clean[:57] + \"...\" if len(desc_clean) > 60 else desc_clean\n                lines.append(\n                    f\"  [CLOSED] {f.finding_id} (sev={f.severity:.2f}): Check string HARDs (exact match, no override)\n    for dotpath, required_value in HARD_STRINGS.items():\n        actual = _dotpath_get(merged, dotpath)\n        if actual is _MISSING:\n            violations.append(\n                f\"  {dotpath}: missing (required {required_value!r})\"\n            )\n        elif actual != required_value:\n            violations.append(\n                f\"  {dotpath}: got {actual!r}, required {required_value!r}\"\n            )\n\n    if violations:\n        detail = \"\\n\".join(violations)\n        raise PolicyViolationError(\n            f\"HARD constraint violation after merging layer '{layer_name}':\\n{detail}\"\n        )\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Public API\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef load_effective_policy(\n    domain: str,\n    task_id: str | None = None,\n    model: str | None = None,\n) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    \"\"\"Build the effective policy by merging all applicable layers.\n\n    Args:\n        domain: Task domain string (e.g. \"mathematics\", \"software\").\n                Maps to the appropriate domain config via DOMAIN_MAP.\n        task_id: Optional task identifier (e.g. \"ma-001\"). If a file\n                 tasks/<task_id>.toml exists, it is merged as Layer 3.\n        model:  Optional model config name without extension (e.g.\n                \"opus_4_6\", \"deepseek_v3\"). Merged as Layer 4.\n\n    Returns:\n        The fully merged policy dict.\n\n    Raises:\n        PolicyViolationError: if any layer weakens a HARD constraint.\n        FileNotFoundError: if universal.toml is missing.\n    \"\"\"\n    # Layer 1: Universal (mandatory)\n    universal_path = REGISTRY_DIR / \"universal.toml\"\n    if not universal_path.exists():\n        raise FileNotFoundError(f\"Universal policy not found: {universal_path}\")\n    policy = _load_toml(universal_path)\n    _check_monotonicity(policy, \"universal\")\n\n    # Layer 2: Domain\n    domain_key = DOMAIN_MAP.get(domain)\n    if domain_key:\n        domain_path = REGISTRY_DIR / \"domains\" / f\"{domain_key}.toml\"\n        if domain_path.exists():\n            domain_config = _load_toml(domain_path)\n            policy = _deep_merge(policy, domain_config)\n            _check_monotonicity(policy, f\"domain/{domain_key}\")\n    else:\n        import warnings\n        warnings.warn(\n            f\"Unknown domain '{domain}' \u2014 no Layer 2 policy applied. \"\n            f\"Known domains: {sorted(DOMAIN_MAP.keys())}\",\n            stacklevel=2,\n        )\n\n    # Layer 3: Task-specific\n    if task_id:\n        task_path = REGISTRY_DIR / \"tasks\" / f\"{task_id}.toml\"\n        if task_path.exists():\n            task_config = _load_toml(task_path)\n            policy = _deep_merge(policy, task_config)\n            _check_monotonicity(policy, f\"task/{task_id}\")\n\n    # Layer 4: Model-specific\n    if model:\n        model_path = REGISTRY_DIR / \"models\" / f\"{model}.toml\"\n        if model_path.exists():\n            model_config = _load_toml(model_path)\n            policy = _deep_merge(policy, model_config)\n            _check_monotonicity(policy, f\"model/{model}\")\n        else:\n            available = [p.stem for p in (REGISTRY_DIR / \"models\").glob(\"*.toml\")]\n            raise FileNotFoundError(\n                f\"Model config not found: {model_path}\\n\"\n                f\"Available models: {available}\"\n            )\n\n    return policy\n\n\ndef validate_all_policies() -> dict[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"Validate every possible single-layer merge against universal.\n\n    Checks that each domain config and each model config, when merged with\n    universal, does not violate monotonicity. Returns a dict mapping\n    config names to \"ok\" or an error message.\n    \"\"\"\n    results: dict[str, str] = {}\n\n    # Load universal once\n    universal_path = REGISTRY_DIR / \"universal.toml\"\n    if not universal_path.exists():\n        return {\"universal\": \"MISSING \u2014 cannot validate anything\"}\n    universal = _load_toml(universal_path)\n\n    try:\n        _check_monotonicity(universal, \"universal\")\n        results[\"universal\"] = \"ok\"\n    except PolicyViolationError as e:\n        results[\"universal\"] = str(e)\n        return results  # If universal itself is broken, stop.\n\n    # Validate each domain config\n    domains_dir = REGISTRY_DIR / \"domains\"\n    if domains_dir.exists():\n        for toml_file in sorted(domains_dir.glob(\"*.toml\")):\n            name = f\"domain/{toml_file.stem}\"\n            try:\n                overlay = _load_toml(toml_file)\n                merged = _deep_merge(universal, overlay)\n                _check_monotonicity(merged, name)\n                results[name] = \"ok\"\n            except (PolicyViolationError, Exception) as e:\n                results[name] = str(e)\n\n    # Validate each model config\n    models_dir = REGISTRY_DIR / \"models\"\n    if models_dir.exists():\n        for toml_file in sorted(models_dir.glob(\"*.toml\")):\n            name = f\"model/{toml_file.stem}\"\n            try:\n                overlay = _load_toml(toml_file)\n                merged = _deep_merge(universal, overlay)\n                _check_monotonicity(merged, name)\n                results[name] = \"ok\"\n            except (PolicyViolationError, Exception) as e:\n                results[name] = str(e)\n\n    # Validate each task config\n    tasks_dir = REGISTRY_DIR / \"tasks\"\n    if tasks_dir.exists():\n        for toml_file in sorted(tasks_dir.glob(\"*.toml\")):\n            name = f\"task/{toml_file.stem}\"\n            try:\n                overlay = _load_toml(toml_file)\n                merged = _deep_merge(universal, overlay)\n                _check_monotonicity(merged, name)\n                results[name] = \"ok\"\n            except (PolicyViolationError, Exception) as e:\n                results[name] = str(e)\n\n    return results\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# CLI entry point\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef main() -> None:\n    \"\"\"Validate all configs and print a sample effective policy.\"\"\"\n    print(\"=\" * 70)\n    print(\"CDSFL Registry \u2014 Policy Validation\")\n    print(\"=\" * 70)\n\n    results = validate_all_policies()\n    all_ok = True\n    for name, status in results.items():\n        indicator = \"PASS\" if status == \"ok\" else \"FAIL\"\n        if status != \"ok\":\n            all_ok = False\n        print(f\"  [{indicator}] {name}\")\n        if status != \"ok\":\n            for line in status.split(\"\\n\"):\n                print(f\"         {line}\")\n\n    print()\n    if not all_ok:\n        print(\"VALIDATION FAILED \u2014 fix the above before running experiments.\")\n        sys.exit(1)\n\n    print(\"All configs valid.\")\n    print()\n\n    # Check threshold HARDs (lower layer cannot reduce below floor)\n    for dotpath, floor in HARD_THRESHOLDS.items():\n        actual = _dotpath_get(merged, dotpath)\n        if actual is _MISSING:\n            violations.append(\n                f\"  {dotpath}: missing (floor is {floor})\"\n            )\n        elif not isinstance(actual, (int, float)):\n            violations.append(\n                f\"  {dotpath}: got {actual!r} (type {type(actual).__name__}), \"\n                f\"expected numeric (floor is {floor})\"\n            )\n        elif actual != actual:  # NaN check: NaN != NaN is True\n            violations.append(\n                f\"  {dotpath}: got NaN, floor is {floor}\"\n            )\n        elif actual < floor:\n            violations.append(\n                f\"  {dotpath}: got {actual}, floor is {floor}\"\n            )\n\n    # Check string HARDs (exact match, no override)\n    for dotpath, required_value in HARD_STRINGS.items():\n        actual = _dotpath_get(merged, dotpath)\n        if actual is _MISSING:\n            violations.append(\n                f\"  {dotpath}: missing (required {required_value!r})\"\n            )\n        elif actual != required_value:\n            violations.append(\n                f\"  {dotpath}: got {actual!r}, required {required_value!r}\"\n            )\n\n    if violations:\n        detail = \"\\n\".join(violations)\n        raise PolicyViolationError(\n            f\"HARD constraint violation after merging layer '{layer_name}':\\n{detail}\"\n        )\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Public API\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef load_effective_policy(\n    domain: str,\n    task_id: str | None = None,\n    model: str | None = None,\n) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    \"\"\"Build the effective policy by merging all applicable layers.\n\n    Args:\n        domain: Task domain string (e.g. \"mathematics\", \"software\").\n                Maps to the appropriate domain config via DOMAIN_MAP.\n        task_id: Optional task identifier (e.g. \"ma-001\"). If a file\n                 tasks/<task_id>.toml exists, it is merged as Layer 3.\n        model:  Optional model config name without extension (e.g.\n                \"opus_4_6\", \"deepseek_v3\"). Merged as Layer 4.\n\n    Returns:\n        The fully merged policy dict.\n\n    Raises:\n        PolicyViolationError: if any layer weakens a HARD constraint.\n        FileNotFoundError: if universal.toml is missing.\n    \"\"\"\n    # Layer 1: Universal (mandatory)\n    universal_path = REGISTRY_DIR / \"universal.toml\"\n    if not universal_path.exists():\n        raise FileNotFoundError(f\"Universal policy not found: {universal_path}\")\n    policy = _load_toml(universal_path)\n    _check_monotonicity(policy, \"universal\")\n\n    # Layer 2: Domain\n    domain_key = DOMAIN_MAP.get(domain)\n    if domain_key:\n        domain_path = REGISTRY_DIR / \"domains\" / f\"{domain_key}.toml\"\n        if domain_path.exists():\n            domain_config = _load_toml(domain_path)\n            policy = _deep_merge(policy, domain_config)\n            _check_monotonicity(policy, f\"domain/{domain_key}\")\n    else:\n        import warnings\n        warnings.warn(\n            f\"Unknown domain '{domain}' \u2014 no Layer 2 policy applied. \"\n            f\"Known domains: {sorted(DOMAIN_MAP.keys())}\",\n            stacklevel=2,\n        )\n\n    # Layer 3: Task-specific\n    if task_id:\n        task_path = REGISTRY_DIR / \"tasks\" / f\"{task_id}.toml\"\n        if task_path.exists():\n            task_config = _load_toml(task_path)\n            policy = _deep_merge(policy, task_config)\n            _check_monotonicity(policy, f\"task/{task_id}\")\n\n    # Layer 4: Model-specific\n    if model:\n        model_path = REGISTRY_DIR / \"models\" / f\"{model}.toml\"\n        if model_path.exists():\n            model_config = _load_toml(model_path)\n            policy = _deep_merge(policy, model_config)\n            _check_monotonicity(policy, f\"model/{model}\")\n        else:\n            available = [p.stem for p in (REGISTRY_DIR / \"models\").glob(\"*.toml\")]\n            raise FileNotFoundError(\n                f\"Model config not found: {model_path}\\n\"\n                f\"Available models: {available}\"\n            )\n\n    return policy\n\n\ndef validate_all_policies() -> dict[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"Validate every possible single-layer merge against universal.\n\n    Checks that each domain config and each model config, when merged with\n    universal, does not violate monotonicity. Returns a dict mapping\n    config names to \"ok\" or an error message.\n    \"\"\"\n    results: dict[str, str] = {}\n\n    # Load universal once\n    universal_path = REGISTRY_DIR / \"universal.toml\"\n    if not universal_path.exists():\n        return {\"universal\": \"MISSING \u2014 cannot validate anything\"}\n    universal = _load_toml(universal_path)\n\n    try:\n        _check_monotonicity(universal, \"universal\")\n        results[\"universal\"] = \"ok\"\n    except PolicyViolationError as e:\n        results[\"universal\"] = str(e)\n        return results  # If universal itself is broken, stop.\n\n    # Validate each domain config\n    domains_dir = REGISTRY_DIR / \"domains\"\n    if domains_dir.exists():\n        for toml_file in sorted(domains_dir.glob(\"*.toml\")):\n            name = f\"domain/{toml_file.stem}\"\n            try:\n                overlay = _load_toml(toml_file)\n                merged = _deep_merge(universal, overlay)\n                _check_monotonicity(merged, name)\n                results[name] = \"ok\"\n            except (PolicyViolationError, Exception) as e:\n                results[name] = str(e)\n\n    # Validate each model config\n    models_dir = REGISTRY_DIR / \"models\"\n    if models_dir.exists():\n        for toml_file in sorted(models_dir.glob(\"*.toml\")):\n            name = f\"model/{toml_file.stem}\"\n            try:\n                overlay = _load_toml(toml_file)\n                merged = _deep_merge(universal, overlay)\n                _check_monotonicity(merged, name)\n                results[name] = \"ok\"\n            except (PolicyViolationError, Exception) as e:\n                results[name] = str(e)\n\n    # Validate each task config\n    tasks_dir = REGISTRY_DIR / \"tasks\"\n    if tasks_dir.exists():\n        for toml_file in sorted(tasks_dir.glob(\"*.toml\")):\n            name = f\"task/{toml_file.stem}\"\n            try:\n                overlay = _load_toml(toml_file)\n                merged = _deep_merge(universal, overlay)\n                _check_monotonicity(merged, name)\n                results[name] = \"ok\"\n            except (PolicyViolationError, Exception) as e:\n                results[name] = str(e)\n\n    return results\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# CLI entry point\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef main() -> None:\n    \"\"\"Validate all configs and print a sample effective policy.\"\"\"\n    print(\"=\" * 70)\n    print(\"CDSFL Registry \u2014 Policy Validation\")\n    print(\"=\" * 70)\n\n    results = validate_all_policies()\n    all_ok = True\n    for name, status in results.items():\n        indicator = \"PASS\" if status == \"ok\" else \"FAIL\"\n        if status != \"ok\":\n            all_ok = False\n        print(f\"  [{indicator}] {name}\")\n        if status != \"ok\":\n            for line in status.split(\"\\n\"):\n                print(f\"         {line}\")\n\n    print()\n    if not all_ok:\n        print(\"VALIDATION FAILED \u2014 fix the above before running experiments.\")\n        sys.exit(1)\n\n    print(\"All configs valid.\")\n    print()\n\n    # Sample: build effective policy for a maths task on Opus 4.6\n    print(\"-\" * 70)\n    print(\"Sample effective policy: domain=mathematics, model=opus_4_6\")\n    print(\"-\" * 70)\n    policy = load_effective_policy(\n        domain=\"mathematics\",\n        model=\"opus_4_6\",\n    )\n    print(json.dumps(policy, indent=2, default=str))\n\n    print()\n    print(\"-\" * 70)\n    print(\"Sample effective policy: domain=software, model=deepseek_v3\")\n    print(\"-\" * 70)\n    policy = load_effective_policy(\n        domain=\"software\",\n        model=\"deepseek_v3\",\n    )\n    print(json.dumps(policy, indent=2, default=str))\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n"

class InsectBrain:
    """Reactive mechanical relay for multi-model CDSFL coordination.

    The brain is the nervous system connecting models, not the consciousness
    directing them. It moves information and tracks metrics. It does not
    evaluate content or direct conversation.

    Usage::

        brain = InsectBrain(
            config=dm_config,
            logs_dir=Path("bench/logs/exp29"),
            source_paths=["bench/immune_agents.py"],
        )
        brain.initialise(model_labels=["CC2", "Gemini", "DeepSeek", "Codex", "ChatGPT"])

        for round_idx in range(max_rounds):
            # Get relay payloads for each model
            payloads = brain.relay(round_idx)

            # Dispatch models (external — brain doesn't call models)
            responses = dispatch_models(payloads)

            # Feed results back to brain
            findings = parse_findings(responses)
            brain.persist(round_idx, responses, findings)

            # Run immune pipeline
            immune_result = brain.run_immune_pipeline(findings)

            # Check convergence
            if brain.check_convergence(round_idx):
                brain.signal_complete()
                break
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        config: DynamicManagementConfig,
        logs_dir: Path,
        source_paths: List[str],
        convergence_detector: Optional[ConvergenceDetector] = None,
    ):
        self.config = config
        self.logs_dir = Path(logs_dir)
        self.source_paths = source_paths
        self.state = BrainState()

        # Convergence detector — reuse existing implementation
        self.conv_detector = convergence_detector or ConvergenceDetector(config)

        # Ensure logs directory exists
        self.logs_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    def initialise(self, model_labels: List[str]) -> None:
        """Set up the brain for a new experiment run.

        Args:
            model_labels: Labels of all participating models.
        """
        self.state = BrainState(
            active_models=list(model_labels),
        )
        logger.info(
            "Insect brain initialised: %d models, logs at %s",
            len(model_labels), self.logs_dir,
        )

    # ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # Core function 1: relay()
    # ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def relay(self, round_idx: int) -> Dict[str, RelayPayload]:
        """Prepare relay payloads for each active model.

        Mechanical formatting only — no editorial changes to findings.
        Each model receives other models' findings (cross-pollination),
        constrained by the per-model context budget.

        Returns dict of model_label → RelayPayload.
        """
        payloads: Dict[str, RelayPayload] = {}

        for model_label in self.state.active_models:
            findings_text, context_reset = self._format_findings_for_model(
                model_label, round_idx,
            )

            # Convergence summary (one line, mechanical)
            if round_idx > 0:
                try:
                    kappa = self.conv_detector.kappa(round_idx - 1)
                    conv_summary = f"Convergence: kappa={kappa:.3f} (threshold={self.config.tau_kappa})"
                except Exception:
                    conv_summary = "Convergence: insufficient data"
            else:
                conv_summary = "Round 0: blind round (no prior data)"

# Experiment 38 Fix Cycle — 10 April 2026

## Overview

Exp 38 Round 0 produced 26 findings, 14 CONFIRMED (70% true positive). The immune
pipeline returned UNEVALUABLE for all fix evaluations. Three gaps identified, all fixed.
Additionally, all 14 confirmed runner bugs were fixed before restart.

**Total: 17 fixes. 714 tests pass (was 690).**

---

## Immune/Endocrine Fixes

### Fix 1: Endocrine SEARCH/REPLACE Parser

**File:** `bench/endocrine.py` — `_apply_fix_to_source()`

**Problem:** CC2 produces structured `<<<< SEARCH ... ==== ... >>>> REPLACE` blocks.
The endocrine fix evaluator had three strategies (prose replace, whole-file, line hints)
but none handled this format. Runner had `parse_search_replace_blocks()` but importing
it would create a circular import.

**Fix:** Inline state machine parser added as Strategy 0 (tried first). Extracts
search/replace pairs from fix text, applies each to source via `str.replace()`.
No external dependencies.

**Tests:** 2 new (`test_search_replace_blocks`, `test_search_replace_blocks_multiple`).

### Fix 2: Target File Fallback

**File:** `bench/endocrine.py` — `_find_target_file()`

**Problem:** CC2 doesn't include `.py` paths in finding descriptions. Regex returns
no matches → function returns None → fix marked UNEVALUABLE.

**Fix:** When `len(source_paths) == 1` and no regex match, return `source_paths[0]`.
Multiple paths with no match still returns None (ambiguous).

**Tests:** 2 updated (`test_no_match_single_path_falls_back`, `test_no_match_multiple_paths_returns_none`).

### Fix 3: Formalisation Agent Promotion

**File:** `bench/immune_agents.py` — `formalisation_agent()`

**Problem:** Shadow-only. Extracted preconditions and logged comparisons but produced
no output feeding into the pipeline. False rejections from B-Cell context erasure were
not corrected.

**Fix:** Returns `Tuple[List[Dict], List[CellVerdict]]`. When B-Cell REJECTED a claim
with extractable preconditions, produces UNCERTAIN counter-verdict (confidence 0.45).
Counter-verdicts added to `all_verdicts` in `run_immune_pipeline()` before reconciliation gate.

**Tests:** 2 updated (`test_runs_on_math_findings_with_counter_verdicts`, `test_skips_behavioural`).

\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\n\ndef _estimate_gamma(novelty_counts: List[int], min_rounds: int = 3) -> float:\n    n = len(novelty_counts)\n    if n < min_rounds:\n        return 0.0\n    cumulative = []\n    total = 0\n    for c in novelty_counts:\n        total += c\n        cumulative.append(total)\n    if total == 0:\n        return 0.0\n    log_x, log_y = [], []\n    for i, cum in enumerate(cumulative):\n        if cum > 0 and (i + 1) > 0:\n            log_x.append(math.log(i + 1))\n            log_y.append(math.log(cum))\n    if len(log_x) < 2:\n        return 0.0\n    n_pts = len(log_x)\n    sum_x = sum(log_x)\n    sum_y = sum(log_y)\n    sum_xy = sum(x * y for x, y in zip(log_x, log_y))\n    sum_x2 = sum(x * x for x in log_x)\n    denom = n_pts * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x\n    if abs(denom) < 1e-12:\n        return 0.0\n    beta = (n_pts * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) / denom\n    return max(0.0, min(1.0, 1.0 - beta))\n\n\nGAMMA_BANDS = [\n    (0.45, float(\"inf\"), \"Strong depletion \u2014 confirms _estimate_gamma(novelty_counts: List[int], min_rounds: int = 3) -> float:\n    n = len(novelty_counts)\n    if n < min_rounds:\n        return 0.0\n    cumulative = []\n    total = 0\n    for c in _estimate_gamma(novelty_counts: List[int], min_rounds: int = 3) -> float:\n    n = len(novelty_counts)\n    if n < min_rounds:\n        return 0.0\n    cumulative = []\n    total = 0\n    for c in novelty_counts:\n        total += c\n        cumulative.append(total)\n    if total == 0:\n        return 0.0\n    log_x, log_y = [], []\n    for i, cum in enumerate(cumulative):\n        if cum > 0 Gamma estimation and convergence\n# \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\n\ndef _estimate_gamma(novelty_counts: List[int], min_rounds: int = 3) -> float:\n    n = len(novelty_counts)\n    if n < min_rounds:\n        return 0.0\n    cumulative = []\n    total = 0\n    for c in novelty_counts:\n        total += c\n        cumulative.append(total)\n    if total == 0:\n        return 0.0\n    log_x, log_y = [], []\n    for i, cum in enumerate(cumulative):\n        if cum > 0 and (i + 1) > 0:\n            log_x.append(math.log(i + 1))\n            log_y.append(math.log(cum))\n    if len(log_x) < 2:\n        return 0.0\n    n_pts = len(log_x)\n    sum_x = sum(log_x)\n    sum_y = sum(log_y)\n    sum_xy = sum(x * y for x, y in zip(log_x, log_y))\n    sum_x2 = sum(x * x for x in log_x)\n    denom = n_pts * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x\n    if abs(denom) < 1e-12:\n _estimate_gamma(novelty_counts: List[int], min_rounds: int = 3) -> float:\n    n = len(novelty_counts)\n    if n < min_rounds:\n        return 0.0\n    cumulative = []\n    total = 0\n    for c in _estimate_gamma(novelty_counts: List[int], min_rounds: int = 3) -> float:\n    n = len(novelty_counts)\n    if n < min_rounds:\n        return 0.0\n    cumulative = []\n    total = 0\n    for c in novelty_counts:\n        total += c\n        cumulative.append(total)\n    if total == 0:\n        return 0.0\n    log_x, log_y = [], []\n    for i, cum in enumerate(cumulative):\n        if cum > 0 and (i + 1) > 0:\n            log_x.append(math.log(i + 1))\n            log_y.append(math.log(cum))\n    if len(log_x) < 2:\n        return 0.0\n    n_pts = len(log_x)\n    sum_x = sum(log_x)\n    sum_y = sum(log_y)\n    sum_xy = sum(x * y for x, y in zip(log_x, log_y))\n    sum_x2 = sum(x * x for x in log_x)\n    denom = n_pts * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x\n    if abs(denom) < 1e-12:\n        return 0.0\n    beta = (n_pts * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) / denom\n    return max(0.0, min(1.0, 1.0 - beta))\n\n\nGAMMA_BANDS = [\n    (0.45, float(\"inf\"), \"Strong depletion \u2014 confirms \"Gamma disagrees with state closure \u2014 recommend HIL audit\"),\n]\n\n\ndef _interpret_gamma(gamma: float) -> str:\n    for low, high, interpretation in GAMMA_BANDS:\n        if low <= gamma < _estimate_gamma(novelty_counts: List[int], min_rounds: int = 3) -> float:\n    n = len(novelty_counts)\n    if n < min_rounds:\n        return 0.0\n    cumulative = []\n    total = 0\n    for c in novelty_counts:\n        total += c\n        cumulative.append(total)\n    if total == 0:\n        return 0.0\n    log_x, log_y = [], []\n    for i, cum in enumerate(cumulative):\n        if cum > 0 and (i + 1) > 0:\n            log_x.append(math.log(i + 1))\n            log_y.append(math.log(cum))\n    if len(log_x) < 2:\n        return 0.0\n    n_pts = len(log_x)\n    sum_x = sum(log_x)\n    sum_y = sum(log_y)\n    sum_xy = sum(x * y for x, y in zip(log_x, log_y))\n    sum_x2 = sum(x * x for x in log_x)\n    denom = n_pts * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x\n    if abs(denom) < 1e-12:\n        return 0.0\n    beta = (n_pts * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) / denom\n    return max(0.0, min(1.0, 1.0 - beta))\n\n\nGAMMA_BANDS = [\n    (0.45, float(\"inf\"), \"Strong depletion \u2014 confirms CYTOTOXIC T-CELL \u2014 Structurally-enforced code investigation\n#\n# The CT agent is an INVESTIGATOR, not a judge. It reads source code and\n# reports what it found at specific file:line locations. This is the structural\n    enforcement \u2014 the agent's claim is tested against reality.\n\n    C5-01 fix: constrain file reads to allowed_dirs (source_paths parents).\n    C5-02 fix: guard against empty string substring bypass.\n\n    Returns:\n        (verified, confidence, reason)\n        - verified: True if snippet matches code at cited location\n        - confidence: 1.0 if exact match, 0.5 if fuzzy, 0.0 if mismatch\n        - reason: explanation of verification result\n    \"\"\"\n    file_path = evidence.get(\"file\", \"\")\n    line_num = evidence.get(\"line\", 0)\n    snippet = evidence.get(\"code_snippet\", \"\").strip()\n\n    # MF-15 fix: use explicit None/empty checks instead of falsy\n    if file_path is None or file_path == \"\" or line_num is None or line_num == 0 or snippet is None or snippet == \"\":\n        return False, 0.0, \"Missing file, line, or code_snippet\"\n\n    # C5-23 fix: bounded line streaming to prevent OOM\n    try:\n        lines: list = []\n        with open(real_path, \"r\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n            for i, line in enumerate(f):\n                if i >= 50000:\n                    break\n                lines.append(line)\n    except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError) as e:\n        return False, 0.0, f\"Cannot read file: {e}\"\n\n    if line_num < 1 or line_num > len(lines):\n        return False, 0.0, f\"Line {line_num} out of range (file has {len(lines)} lines)\"\n\n    # The agent says \"bug_exists\" but\n    if none of its evidence checks out, the verdict is UNCERTAIN.\n\n    Rules:\n        - All evidence verified + claim_type in (bug_exists, logic_error,\n          code_missing) \u2192 CONFIRMED (the finding is probably real)\n        - All evidence verified + claim_type in (bug_absent, no_error,\n          code_present) \u2192 REJECTED (the finding is probably false)\n        - Mixed or no evidence verified \u2192 UNCERTAIN\n        - No evidence at all \u2192 UNCERTAIN\n    \"\"\"\n    if not evidence_items:\n        return CellVerdict(\n            cell_type=CellType.CYTOTOXIC_T,\n            finding_id=finding_id,\n            verdict=\"UNCERTAIN\",\n            confidence=0.0,\n            evidence=\"CT agent provided no evidence\",\n            tool_used=\"ct_mechanical\",\n        )\n\n    verifications = []\n    for ev in evidence_items:\n        verified, conf, reason = _verify_ct_claim(ev, allowed_dirs=allowed_dirs)\n        verifications.append((verified, conf, reason))\n\n    verified_count = sum(1 for v, _, _ in verifications if v)\n    total = len(verifications)\n    avg_confidence = sum(c for _, c, _ in verifications) / max(total, 1)\n\n    # Full JSON object with \"verdicts\" array (schema-enforced)\n    1b. C5-05 fix: extract JSON from markdown code blocks (```json...```)\n    2. JSON lines (one object per line, legacy format)\n    3. Extract JSON from mixed text (agent didn't follow schema perfectly)\n    \"\"\"\n    # Strategy 1: Full JSON with verdicts array\n    try:\n        data = json.loads(output)\n        if isinstance(data, dict) and \"verdicts\" in data:\n            return data[\"verdicts\"]\n    except json.JSONDecodeError:\n        pass\n\n    # MF-29 fix: also match STRONG_CORRELATION and MODERATE_CORRELATION\n    stripped_stat = output.strip()\n    # Bug#72 fix: also match CI and mean claim types\n    if ((\"SIGNIFICANT\" in stripped_stat and \"NOT_SIGNIFICANT\" not in stripped_stat)\n            or stripped_stat.startswith(\"STRONG_CORRELATION\")\n            or stripped_stat.startswith(\"MODERATE_CORRELATION\")\n            or stripped_stat.startswith(\"STAT_CI_VALID\")\n            or stripped_stat.startswith(\"STAT_MEAN\")):\n        return CellVerdict(\n            cell_type=CellType.B_CELL, finding_id=\"\", verdict=\"CONFIRMED\",\n            confidence=0.80, evidence=f\"stats: {output}\", tool_used=\"statsmodels\",\n            elapsed_s=elapsed,\n        )\n    elif (\"NOT_SIGNIFICANT\" in stripped_stat\n            or stripped_stat.startswith(\"WEAK_CORRELATION\")\n            or stripped_stat.startswith(\"STAT_CI_INVALID\")):\n        return CellVerdict(\n            cell_type=CellType.B_CELL, finding_id=\"\", verdict=\"REJECTED\",\n            confidence=0.80, evidence=f\"stats: {output}\", tool_used=\"statsmodels\",\n            elapsed_s=elapsed,\n        )\n    else:\n        return CellVerdict(\n            cell_type=CellType.B_CELL, finding_id=\"\", verdict=\"UNCERTAIN\",\n            confidence=0.2, evidence=f\"stats: {output}\", tool_used=\"statsmodels\",\n            elapsed_s=elapsed,\n        )\n\n\ndef b_cell_verify(triaged: List[TriagedFinding]) -> List[CellVerdict]:\n    \"\"\"Stage 2b: Mathematical/logical/statistical verification.\n\n    The B-Cell uses somatic hypermutation \u2014 it adapts its verification\n    strategy based on the claim type. NK CELL \u2014 Pattern recognition, dedup, and immune memory\n# \u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\n\n# Known false-positive patterns from Run 7b analysis\n# MF-18 fix: add re.DOTALL to FP patterns for multiline descriptions\n_KNOWN_FALSE_POSITIVES: List[Dict[str, Any]] = [\n    {\n        \"pattern\": re.compile(r\"@dataclass\\s+decorator.*missing\", re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL),\n        \"source\": \"Run 7b: Codex hallucinated missing @dataclass 8 times\",\n        \"expected_model\": \"Codex\",\n    },\n    {\n        \"pattern\": re.compile(r\"missing\\s+@dataclass\", re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL),\n        \"source\": \"Run 7b: @dataclass false positive cluster\",\n        \"expected_model\": \"Codex\",\n    },\n]\n\n\ndef nk_cell_verify(\n    triaged: List[TriagedFinding],\n    prior_findings: List[Finding],\n    tau_sim: float = 0.50,  # Raised from 0.33: class_match base (0.30) + shared\n                            # vocabulary caused 90-100% false DUPLICATE by mid-run.\n                            # At 0.50, same-class needs Jaccard >= 0.286 (real overlap).\n    false_positive_db: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = None,\n) -> Tuple[List[TriagedFinding], List[CellVerdict]]:\n    \"\"\"Stage 2c: Pattern recognition and deduplication.\n\n    The NK Cell provides innate-like immunity with adaptive memory.\n    It matches findings against:\n    1. Prior findings (dedup via similarity)\n    2. Known false-positive patterns (memory from prior runs)\n    3. Anomaly detection (severity outliers, repeated hallucinations)\n\n    Returns updated triaged findings with duplicate flags set,\n    plus verdicts for pattern-matched findings.\n    \"\"\"\n    fp_db = false_positive_db or _KNOWN_FALSE_POSITIVES\n    verdicts: List[CellVerdict] = []\n\n    for tf in triaged:\n        f = tf.finding\n\n        # 1. Dedup against prior findings\n        # MF-19 fix: early termination once a match exceeds threshold\n        best_sim = 0.0\n        best_match: Optional[str] = None\n        for pf in prior_findings:\n            sim = _finding_similarity(f, pf)\n            if sim > best_sim:\n                best_sim = sim\n                best_match = pf.finding_id\n                if best_sim >= tau_sim:\n                    break  # MF-19: early termination\n\n        # MF-16 fix: assert best_match is not None (prevent phantom duplicates)\n        if best_sim >= tau_sim and best_match is not None:\n            # Bug-closed gate (v1 parity with v2): if matched finding\n            # already has a programmatically verified fix, this bug is closed.\n            matched_pf = next(\n                (pf for pf in prior_findings if pf.finding_id == best_match),\n                None,\n            )\n            has_fix = (\n                matched_pf is not None\n                and bool(matched_pf.proposed_fix.strip())\n                and matched_pf.verified\n            )\n            is_escalated = (\n                matched_pf is not None\n                and matched_pf.escalated\n            )\n            tf.is_duplicate = True\n            tf.duplicate_of = best_match\n            tf.similarity = best_sim\n            if has_fix:\n                _evidence = f\"Bug CLOSED \u2014 dup of {best_match} (sim={best_sim:.3f}), fix exists\"\n                _tool = \"bug_closed\"\n            elif is_escalated:\n                _evidence = f\"Bug ESCALATED \u2014 dup of {best_match} (sim={best_sim:.3f}), awaiting HIL\"\n                _tool = \"escalated\"\n            else:\n                _evidence = f\"Duplicate of {best_match} (sim={best_sim:.3f})\"\n                _tool = \"similarity_dedup\"\n            verdicts.append(CellVerdict(\n                cell_type=CellType.NK_CELL,\n                finding_id=f.finding_id,\n                verdict=\"DUPLICATE\",\n                confidence=best_sim,\n                evidence=_evidence,\n                tool_used=_tool,\n            ))\n            continue\n\n        # 2. Check against known false-positive patterns\n        # Bug#10 fix: track FP match to skip anomaly detection (v1 control flow leak)\n        is_fp = False\n        for fp in fp_db:\n            if fp[\"pattern\"].search(f.description):\n                model_match = (\n                    not fp.get(\"expected_model\")\n                    or fp[\"expected_model\"] == f.model_id\n                )\n                if model_match:\n                    verdicts.append(CellVerdict(\n                        cell_type=CellType.NK_CELL,\n                        finding_id=f.finding_id,\n                        verdict=\"REJECTED\",\n                        confidence=0.90,\n                        evidence=f\"Known FP: {fp['source']}\",\n                        tool_used=\"false_positive_db\",\n                    ))\n                    is_fp = True\n                    break\n\n        if is_fp:\n            continue  # Bug#10 fix: skip anomaly detection for known FPs\n\n        # 3. Anomaly detection: severity outliers\n        # MF-17 fix: emit REJECTED (not UNCERTAIN) for anomalous findings\n        if f.severity > 0.95 and f.round_idx > 5:\n            verdicts.append(CellVerdict(\n                cell_type=CellType.NK_CELL,\n                finding_id=f.finding_id,\n                verdict=\"REJECTED\",\n                confidence=0.6,\n                evidence=f\"Late-round high severity ({f.severity:.2f} at R{f.round_idx}) \u2014 possible inflation\",\n                tool_used=\"anomaly_detection\",\n            ))\n\n    return triaged, verdicts\n\n\n# \u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\n# 5. HELPER T-CELL \u2014 Verdict synthesis\n# \u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\n\ndef helper_t_cell_synthesize(\n    triaged: List[TriagedFinding],\n    all_verdicts: List[CellVerdict],\n) -> Tuple[Dict[str, str], Dict[str, float]]:\n    \"\"\"Stage 3a: Synthesize all cell verdicts into final judgments.\n\n    The Helper T-Cell coordinates the immune response by aggregating\n    verdicts from all cell types. Uses confidence-weighted voting:\n    - CONFIRMED verdicts contribute positive weight\n    - REJECTED verdicts contribute negative weight\n    - UNCERTAIN verdicts contribute nothing\n    - DUPLICATE verdicts are auto-rejected\n\n    A finding needs net positive confidence to survive.\n    Asymmetric threshold: rejection requires 0.6+ net confidence,\n    confirmation requires only 0.4+ (false negatives are costlier\n    than false positives).\n    \"\"\"\n    # Group verdicts by finding \u2014 MF-11 fix: deduplicate by cell type\n    # (keep highest-confidence verdict per cell type per finding)\n    verdicts_by_finding: Dict[str, List[CellVerdict]] = {}\n    for v in all_verdicts:\n        verdicts_by_finding.setdefault(v.finding_id, []).append(v)\n\n    # Deduplicate: one verdict per cell type per finding\n    for fid in verdicts_by_finding:\n        seen_cells: Dict[CellType, CellVerdict] = {}\n        for v in verdicts_by_finding[fid]:\n            if v.cell_type not in seen_cells or v.confidence > seen_cells[v.cell_type].confidence:\n                seen_cells[v.cell_type] = v\n        verdicts_by_finding[fid] = list(seen_cells.values())\n\n    final_verdicts: Dict[str, str] = {}\n    final_confidences: Dict[str, float] = {}\n\n    for tf in triaged:\n        fid = tf.finding.finding_id\n        fv = verdicts_by_finding.get(fid, [])\n\n        # Auto-reject duplicates\n        if tf.is_duplicate:\n            final_verdicts[fid] = \"DUPLICATE\"\n            final_confidences[fid] = tf.similarity\n            continue\n\n        # Confidence-weighted voting\n        confirm_weight = 0.0\n        reject_weight = 0.0\n\n        for v in fv:\n            if v.verdict == \"CONFIRMED\":\n                confirm_weight += v.confidence\n            elif v.verdict == \"REJECTED\":\n                reject_weight += v.confidence\n            elif v.verdict == \"DUPLICATE\":\n                reject_weight += v.confidence\n            # UNCERTAIN contributes nothing\n\n        total = confirm_weight + reject_weight\n        if total == 0:\n            # No verdicts \u2014 pass through (precautionary principle)\n            final_verdicts[fid] = \"UNCERTAIN\"\n            final_confidences[fid] = 0.0\n        elif reject_weight / max(total, 0.001) >= 0.6:\n            final_verdicts[fid] = \"REJECTED\"\n            # MF-09 fix: cap confidence by max individual verdict weight\n            max_individual = max((v.confidence for v in fv if v.verdict in (\"REJECTED\", \"DUPLICATE\")), default=0.0)\n            final_confidences[fid] = min(reject_weight / total, max_individual)\n        elif confirm_weight / max(total, 0.001) >= 0.4:\n            final_verdicts[fid] = \"CONFIRMED\"\n            # MF-09 fix: cap confidence by max individual verdict weight\n            max_individual = max((v.confidence for v in fv if v.verdict == \"CONFIRMED\"), default=0.0)\n            final_confidences[fid] = min(confirm_weight / total, max_individual)\n        else:\n            final_verdicts[fid] = \"UNCERTAIN\"\n            final_confidences[fid] = max(confirm_weight, reject_weight) / max(total, 0.001)\n\n    return final_verdicts, final_confidences\n\n\n# \u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\n# 6. REGULATORY T-CELL \u2014 Meta-verification and autoimmune prevention\n# \u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\u2550\n\ndef regulatory_t_cell_check(\n    final_verdicts: Dict[str, str],\n    triaged: List[TriagedFinding],\n    max_rejection_rate: float = 0.65,\n    min_findings_for_check: int = 5,\n) -> Tuple[bool, str]:\n    \"\"\"Stage 3b: Check for autoimmune response (over-rejection).\n\n    The Regulatory T-Cell prevents the immune system from attacking\n    valid findings. If the rejection rate exceeds the threshold,\n    it flags an autoimmune condition \u2014 the verification pipeline\n    itself may be miscalibrated.\n\n    Returns:\n        (autoimmune_flag, reason)\n    \"\"\"\n    total = len(final_verdicts)\n    if total < min_findings_for_check:\n        return False, f\"Too few findings ({total}) for meta-check\"\n\n    rejected = sum(1 for v in final_verdicts.values() if v == \"REJECTED\")\n    duplicated = sum(1 for v in final_verdicts.values() if v == \"DUPLICATE\")\n    removed = rejected + duplicated\n    removal_rate = removed / total\n\n    reasons = []\n\n    # Check 1: Overall rejection rate\n    if rejected / total > max_rejection_rate:\n        reasons.append(\n            f\"Rejection rate {rejected}/{total} rejections\n    # (indicates a miscalibrated tool, not genuine false positives)\n    # We'd need per-cell rejection counts here \u2014 tracked via verdicts\n\n    # Check 3: All findings from one model rejected\n    model_counts: Dict[str, int] = {}\n    model_rejected: Dict[str, int] = {}\n    for tf in triaged:\n        mid = tf.finding.model_id\n        model_counts[mid] = model_counts.get(mid, 0) + 1\n        if final_verdicts.get(tf.finding.finding_id) == \"REJECTED\":\n            model_rejected[mid] = model_rejected.get(mid, 0) + 1\n\n    for mid, total_m in model_counts.items():\n        rej_m = model_rejected.get(mid, 0)\n        if total_m >= 3 and rej_m == total_m:\n            reasons.append(\n                f\"All {total_m} findings from {mid} rejected \u2014 \"\n                f\"possible systematic bias against this model\"\n            )\n\n    if reasons:\n        return True, \"; \".join(reasons)\n\n    return False, f\"Pipeline healthy: {removal_rate:.1%} removal rate\"\n\n\n# If the cited code doesn't\n    exist at the cited location, the finding fails the barrier.\n\n    In shadow mode (Run 11), all findings pass through regardless.\n    The results are logged for observation.\n\n    Returns:\n        (all_findings, barrier_results) \u2014 findings unchanged in shadow mode\n    \"\"\"\n    results: List[SkinBarrierResult] = []\n    source_set = set(str(p) for p in source_paths)\n\n    # Also build a set of relative paths and basenames for fuzzy matching\n    # Bug#69 fix: track ambiguous basenames (multiple paths for same name)\n    source_basenames: Dict[str, str] = {}\n    _ambiguous_basenames: Set[str] = set()\n    for p in source_paths:\n        bn = os.path.basename(str(p))\n        if bn in source_basenames:\n            _ambiguous_basenames.add(bn)\n        source_basenames[bn] = str(p)\n\n    for f in findings:\n        desc = f.description\n\n        # Bug#41 fix: line-only citations cannot be verified without a file path.\n            # Pass by default rather than creating unresolvable citations.\n            pass\n\n        if not citations:\n            # No citations to check \u2014 passes by default\n            results.append(SkinBarrierResult(\n                finding_id=f.finding_id, passed=True,\n                reason=\"No file:line citation to verify\",\n            ))\n            continue\n\n        # Try partial path match\n            else:\n                for sp_path in source_paths:\n                    if str(sp_path).endswith(cited_file_raw):\n                        cited_file = str(sp_path)\n                        break\n\n        if not cited_file:\n            results.append(SkinBarrierResult(\n                finding_id=f.finding_id, passed=False,\n                reason=f\"Cited file not found: {cited_file_raw}\",\n                cited_file=cited_file_raw, cited_line=cited_line,\n            ))\n            continue\n\n        # Try exact, then basename\n            exists = (\n                os.path.isfile(file_arg)\n                or file_arg in source_set\n                or os.path.basename(file_arg) in source_basenames\n            )\n            if exists:\n                verified += 1\n            else:\n                issues.append(f\"File not found: {file_arg}\")\n\n        elif tool in (\"Grep\", \"grep\", \"rg\"):\n            # FP check \u2014 with continue fix (v1 bug: fell through to anomaly)\n        is_fp = False\n        for fp in fp_db:\n            if fp[\"pattern\"].search(f.description):\n                model_match = (\n                    not fp.get(\"expected_model\")\n                    or fp[\"expected_model\"] == f.model_id\n                )\n                if model_match:\n                    verdicts.append(CellVerdict(\n                        cell_type=CellType.NK_CELL,\n                        finding_id=f.finding_id,\n                        verdict=\"REJECTED\",\n                        confidence=0.90,\n                        evidence=f\"[NK_v2] Known FP: {fp['source']}\",\n                        tool_used=\"v2_false_positive_db\",\n                    ))\n                    is_fp = True\n                    break\n\n        if is_fp:\n            continue  # v2 FIX: skip anomaly detection for known FPs\n\n        # 3.
